Cloudflare’s edge and network make it possible to solve problems at massive scale and efficiency which would be impossible for almost any other organization.</p> <p>ETI's Storage Infrastructure team is responsible for the core storage layer that underpins many of ETI's stateful services. We run this infrastructure globally across Cloudflare's network, which presents unique and complex engineering puzzles. We navigate efficiently expanding storage capacity, optimizing rebuild operations, and coordinating operations across failure domains to uphold durability. $254,000</li> </ul> <h3>Equity</h3> <p>This role is eligible to participate in Cloudflare’s equity plan.</p> <h3>Benefits</h3> <p>Cloudflare offers a complete package of benefits and programs to support you and your family.  Our benefits programs can help you pay health care expenses, support caregiving, build capital for the future and make life a little easier and fun!  The below is a description of our benefits for employees in the United States, and benefits may vary for employees based outside the U.S.</p> <h3>Health & Welfare Benefits</h3> <ul> <li>Medical/Rx Insurance</li> <li>Dental Insurance</li> <li>Vision Insurance</li> <li>Flexible Spending Accounts</li> <li>Commuter Spending Accounts</li> <li>Fertility & Family Forming Benefits</li> <li>On-demand mental health support and Employee Assistance Program</li> <li>Global Travel Medical Insurance</li> </ul> <h3>Financial Benefits</h3> <ul> <li>Short and Long Term Disability Insurance</li> <li>Life & Accident Insurance</li> <li>401(k) Retirement Savings Plan</li> <li>Employee Stock Participation Plan</li> </ul> <h3>Time Off</h3> <ul> <li>Flexible paid time off covering vacation and sick leave</li> <li>Leave programs, including parental, pregnancy health, medical, and bereavement leave</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><h3><strong>Available Locations: Lisbon, or London (Hybrid)</strong></h3> <div class="container"> <div id="model-response-message-contentr_ccb59069932b9a6f" class="markdown markdown-main-panel md-content enable-luminous-fast-follows enable-updated-hr-color stronger tutor-markdown-rendering"> <h3>About the Department</h3> <p>Emerging Technologies & Incubation (ETI) is where new and bold products are built and released within Cloudflare. Rather than being constrained by the structures which make Cloudflare a hugely successful business, we are able to leverage them to deliver entirely new tools and products to our customers. Cloudflare’s edge and network make it possible to solve problems at massive scale and efficiency which would be impossible for almost any other organization.</p> <h3>About the Team</h3> <p>We build the products that enable the next era of the Internet: making domains <strong>Readable</strong>, <strong>Discoverable</strong>, and <strong>Callable</strong> for autonomous AI agents.</p> <p>Here at Cloudflare, agentic discovery is a core part of our vision for the <a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/the-agentic-internet/">Agentic Internet</a>. As AI agents change how humans and machines find, evaluate, and act on information, businesses need tools to control how they are represented and reached. We build capabilities that enable website owners to prepare their sites for agent interaction, test and observe how agents read their content, establish open interaction standards (like WebMCP and MCP), and create entirely new channels to reach agentic audiences.</p> <p>We are a cross functional group that communicates and collaborates regularly. We celebrate our achievements, support each other when we make mistakes, and hold each other and our work to a high standard.</p> <h3>About the Role</h3> <p>We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer to serve as a technical anchor and become a subject matter expert on our Agentic Discovery team. In this role, you will define the architecture, core protocols, and multi-team standards powering the next generation of agent-web interactions.</p> <p>As a senior technical leader, you will shape product roadmaps, mentor engineers across Cloudflare, and write technical specifications that drive execution across multiple teams. with product managers and customers to navigate ambiguous problem spaces and iteratively deliver large-scale architecture.</li> <li>Experience mentoring junior and mid-level engineers, contributing to hiring, and driving improvements to engineering processes and incident response workflows.</li> </ul> <h3>Bonus Points</h3> <ul> <li>Fluency in async Rust or TypeScript/JavaScript edge runtimes (e.g., Build executable plans with Cloudflare WAN, Gateway, DEX, the Cloudflare One Client, and platform and security teams.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Role Requirements</strong></h2> <h3><strong>Must-Have Skills</strong></h3> <ul> <li>8+ years of professional software engineering experience building complex production systems.</li> <li>Strong software engineering skills in Rust, C/C++, Go, or a comparable system programming language, with the ability to work across the stack, including TypeScript.</li> <li>Strong understanding of Linux networking internals, with experience building against the kernel networking stack using eBPF/XDP, netlink, and network namespaces.</li> <li>Experience designing and implementing distributed control planes, desired-state reconciliation, remote configuration, or similar systems that manage large, intermittently connected fleets.</li> <li>Experience designing secure systems, including threat modeling, least privilege, credential handling, and software supply-chain integrity.</li> <li>A track record of owning ambiguous initiatives from discovery through production, including architecture, implementation, staged deployment, incident response, and failure analysis.</li> <li>Technical leadership and communication skills that let you influence decisions, explain system trade-offs to different audiences, and bring stakeholders toward a clear outcome.</li> <li>Product judgment grounded in customer evidence, usability, and operational simplicity.</li> <li>Practical experience using AI-assisted engineering tools, coding agents, harnesses, or automation responsibly to improve engineering quality and throughput.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Nice-to-Have Skills</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Experience building networking products or dynamic routing, multi-WAN, traffic steering or shaping, application identification, or local policy enforcement.</li> <li>Experience building automated fleet tests, hardware-in-the-loop or Dabei wird ausdrücklich kein klassischer Projektmanager gesucht, der Projekte ausschließlich koordiniert. title: Senior Infrastructure Engineer, Storage Platform
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><h3>Available Locations | Austin, US; Seattle, US or London, UK</h3> <h3>About the Role</h3> <p>Emerging Technologies & Incubation (ETI) builds and launches new products on Cloudflare’s global network. Within ETI, you’ll join the Storage Infrastructure team to build and operate a shared storage platform for the teams behind stateful products such as R2, Workers KV, and Durable Objects.</p> <p>We manage the underlying storage hardware, distributed databases, and object storage clusters, including fleet lifecycle automation, capacity, hardware validation, failure-domain planning, observability, and production operations. In this role, you will build platform software and automation that makes these fleet operations safe, repeatable, and scalable.</p> <h3>Responsibilities</h3> <ul> <li>Design and build automation and operator tooling for provisioning, configuring, expanding, upgrading, and decommissioning storage hardware, distributed databases, and object storage clusters.</li> <li>Engineer globally distributed storage fleets to tolerate hardware failures, network disruption, capacity pressure, and recovery events across multiple failure domains.</li> <li>Develop observability, alerting, and safety controls that help engineers understand fleet health and make auditable production changes.</li> <li>Diagnose incidents across Linux, storage, networking, and distributed systems; participate in on-call and implement durable fixes that reduce operational toil.</li> <li>Use AI tools throughout development and operations to accelerate debugging, incident triage, root-cause analysis, and toil reduction, while applying sound engineering judgment and verifying outputs before taking production action.</li> <li>Validate new storage hardware and characterize its performance during normal operation, failures, rebuilds, and other recovery conditions.</li> <li>Partner with R2, Workers KV, Durable Objects, Network, Capacity Planning, Performance Engineering, and Infrastructure Operations to turn service requirements into infrastructure capabilities.</li> </ul> <h3>Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience</h3> <ul> <li>Experience designing, building, and operating infrastructure platforms or large-scale production fleets, including automation of lifecycle operations.</li> <li>Strong Linux systems knowledge and experience troubleshooting across compute, storage, and networking layers.</li> <li>Experience operating distributed systems in production, including observability, incident response, reliability improvements, and safe change management.</li> <li>Ability to write maintainable software in at least one programming language, such as Go, Rust, or Python.</li> <li>Strong written and verbal communication skills, with experience collaborating across engineering teams and technical stakeholders.</li> </ul> <h3>Bonus Points</h3> <ul> <li>Experience operating distributed databases or object storage systems, with knowledge of storage fundamentals such as filesystems, SSD behavior, replication, and rebuild dynamics.</li> <li>Experience with bare-metal provisioning, hardware lifecycle management, or storage hardware validation.</li> <li>Experience with infrastructure-as-code, configuration-management, or observability systems such as Terraform, SaltStack, Prometheus, or Grafana.</li> <li>Experience with capacity modeling, workload placement, failure-domain planning, or cross-datacenter networking.</li> </ul> <h3>Compensation</h3> <p>Compensation may be adjusted depending on work location.</p> <ul> <li>For New York City, New Jersey, Washington, Washington DC, and California (excluding Bay Area) based hires: Estimated annual salary of $185,000 - $254,000</li> </ul> <h3>Equity</h3> <p>This role is eligible to participate in Cloudflare’s equity plan.</p> <h3>Benefits</h3> <p>Cloudflare offers a complete package of benefits and programs to support you and your family.  Our benefits programs can help you pay health care expenses, support caregiving, build capital for the future and make life a little easier and fun!  The below is a description of our benefits for employees in the United States, and benefits may vary for employees based outside the U.S.</p> <h3>Health & Welfare Benefits</h3> <ul> <li>Medical/Rx Insurance</li> <li>Dental Insurance</li> <li>Vision Insurance</li> <li>Flexible Spending Accounts</li> <li>Commuter Spending Accounts</li> <li>Fertility & Family Forming Benefits</li> <li>On-demand mental health support and Employee Assistance Program</li> <li>Global Travel Medical Insurance</li> </ul> <h3>Financial Benefits</h3> <ul> <li>Short and Long Term Disability Insurance</li> <li>Life & Accident Insurance</li> <li>401(k) Retirement Savings Plan</li> <li>Employee Stock Participation Plan</li> </ul> <h3>Time Off</h3> <ul> <li>Flexible paid time off covering vacation and sick leave</li> <li>Leave programs, including parental, pregnancy health, medical, and bereavement leave</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.</span></p> <p><a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/protecting-free-expression-online/"><strong>Project Galileo</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.</span></p> <p><strong><a href="https://www.cloudflare.com/athenian/">Athenian Project</a></strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.</span></p> <p><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"><strong>1.1.1.1</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: We released</span><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"> <span style="font-weight: 400;">1.1.1.1</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. title: Engineering Manager - Workers Runtime, Edge Team
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><h3><strong>Available Locations: Austin, Lisbon, or London (Hybrid)</strong></h3> <h3>About the Role</h3> <p>Emerging Technologies & Incubation (ETI) is where new and bold products are built and released within Cloudflare. Rather than being constrained by the structures which make Cloudflare a massively successful business, we are able to leverage them to deliver entirely new tools and products to our customers. Cloudflare’s edge and network make it possible to solve problems at massive scale and efficiency which would be impossible for almost any other organization.</p> <p>The Workers Runtime team delivers features and improvements to our Runtime which actually executes customer code at the edge. We care deeply about increasing performance, improving JS API surface area and compiled language support through WebAssembly, and optimizing to meet the next 10x increase in scale. The Runtime is a hostile environment - system resources such as memory, cpu, I/O, etc need to be managed extremely carefully and security must be foundational in everything we do.</p> <p>Our work is deeply systems-oriented. We build and maintain the C++ and Rust codebase that embeds the JavaScript engine, manages isolate lifecycles, enforces resource limits (CPU, memory, I/O), and orchestrates how customer scripts are loaded, cached, and executed. We operate in a hostile multi-tenant environment where security must be foundational — from side-channel attack mitigations to isolate sandboxing — and performance is measured in microseconds.</p> <h3>Responsibilities</h3> <p>You will lead the Workers Runtime - Edge team, owning the runtime service in production across Cloudflare’s fleet and driving the architectural evolution of the platform.</p> <ul> <li>Lead a team of senior systems engineers working in C++ and Rust on one of Cloudflare’s most performance-critical and security-sensitive services.</li> <li>Drive major infrastructure initiatives, including migrating legacy systems, redesigning core abstractions, and laying the groundwork for next-generation runtime architecture.</li> <li>Own reliability and release safety for a service handling tens of millions of requests per second.</li> <li>Improve release processes, invest in health monitoring and automated rollback, and help the team ship changes confidently at scale.</li> <li>Make prioritisation calls between customer-unblocking feature work and foundational investment in security, reliability, and developer velocity.</li> <li>Partner closely with adjacent teams across the Developer Platform to ensure the runtime supports the broader product roadmap, including compute, storage, networking, and observability.</li> <li>Hire, grow, and develop strong systems engineers; set clear expectations, provide technical mentorship, and create an environment where people do their best work.</li> </ul> <h3>Desirable Skills, Knowledge & Experience</h3> <ul> <li>Experience leading a team.</li> <li>Comfortable leading and hiring a team that builds low-level distributed systems.</li> <li>Strong planning skills, with experience creating teams and overseeing execution to meet commitments predictably.</li> <li>Comfortable building developer-loved APIs that scale.</li> <li>Track record of leading a team through hiring, onboarding, and professional development.</li> <li>Ability to explain both the “why” and the “how.”</li> <li>Experience implementing tools, process improvements, internal instrumentation, methodologies, and resolving blockages.</li> <li>At least 4 years of recent professional experience with C++ or Rust.</li> <li>Solid understanding of computer science fundamentals, including data structures, algorithms, and object-oriented or functional design.</li> <li>Deep understanding of the web and technologies such as web browsers, HTTP, JavaScript, and WebAssembly.</li> <li>Strong understanding of Linux systems programming, process models, and networking.</li> </ul> <h3>Bonus Points</h3> <ul> <li>Experience building high-performance distributed systems.</li> <li>Experience working with cloud platforms, especially server-less platforms.</li> <li>Experience with the internals of JS engines such as V8, SpiderMonkey, or JavaScriptCore.</li> <li>Experience with standalone WebAssembly runtimes such as Wasmtime, Wasmer, Lucet, etc.</li> <li>Deep Linux/UNIX systems, kernel, or networking knowledge.</li> <li>Contributions to large open source projects.</li> <li>Experience working in low-latency real-time environments such as game streaming, game engine architecture, high-frequency trading, or payment systems.</li> <li>Experience debugging, optimizing, and identifying failure modes in a large-scale Linux-based distributed system.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Compensation</strong></h3> <p><strong>Compensation may be adjusted depending on work location.</strong></p> <p><strong>● </strong>For New York City, New Jersey, Washington, Washington DC, and California (excluding Bay Area) based hires: Estimated annual salary of $220,000 - $303,000</p> <p data-path-to-node="1">● For Portugal based hires: Estimated annual salary is between €89,000 - €122,000.</p> <ul data-path-to-node="2"> <li> <p data-path-to-node="2,0,0">The final offer will be inclusive of time exemption, in alignment with the applicable law and collective bargaining agreements.</p> </li> </ul> <h3 data-path-to-node="3"><strong data-path-to-node="3" data-index-in-node="0">Equity</strong></h3> <p data-path-to-node="4">This role is eligible to participate in Cloudflare’s equity plan.</p> <h3><strong>Benefits</strong></h3> <p>Cloudflare offers a complete package of benefits and programs to support you and your family.  Our benefits programs can help you pay health care expenses, support caregiving, build capital for the future and make life a little easier and fun!  The below is a description of our benefits for employees in the United States, and benefits may vary for employees based outside the U.S.</p> <h3><strong>Health & Welfare Benefits</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Medical/Rx Insurance</li> <li>Dental Insurance</li> <li>Vision Insurance</li> <li>Flexible Spending Accounts</li> <li>Commuter Spending Accounts</li> <li>Fertility & Family Forming Benefits</li> <li>On-demand mental health support and Employee Assistance Program</li> <li>Global Travel Medical Insurance</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Financial Benefits</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Short and Long Term Disability Insurance</li> <li>Life & Accident Insurance</li> <li>401(k) Retirement Savings Plan</li> <li>Employee Stock Participation Plan</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Time Off</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Flexible paid time off covering vacation and sick leave</li> <li>Leave programs, including parental, pregnancy health, medical, and bereavement leave</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. title: Praktikum (m/w/d) Finance & Accounting
description: Wir bei Repower Solution glauben daran, dass die Zukunft der Energie grün, smart und nachhaltig ist. Willst Du weg von der Theorie und praktisch mit anpacken? Dann unterstütze uns als Praktikant (m/w/d) dabei, unsere Finanzen im Hintergrund stabil aufzustellen und die Energiewende auch zahlenmäßig auf Erfolgskurs zu halten. Als junges, dynamisches Unternehmen entwickeln wir innovative Lösungen für die Energiewende – praxisnah, technologiegetrieben und mit echtem Impact. Unser Team besteht aus leidenschaftlichen Profis, die nicht nur in Photovoltaik, Elektromobilität und Wärmepumpentechnologie zuhause sind, sondern auch Finanzierungsmöglichkeiten clever mitdenken. Gemeinsam mit unseren Kunden setzen wir zukunftsweisende Projekte um – von der ersten Idee bis zur erfolgreichen Umsetzung. Aufgaben Vorbereitende Buchhaltung: Du unterstützt unser Finance-Team im operativen Tagesgeschäft und sorgst dafür, dass alle Prozesse reibungslos laufen. Belegmanagement: Du übernimmst die digitale Belegablage sowie die lückenlose Belegnachverfolgung. Zahlungsabgleich & OPOS: Du hast die offenen Posten (OPOS-Listen) fest im Blick und übernimmst den eigenständigen Zahlungsabgleich. Rechnungsprüfung: Du prüfst eingehende Rechnungen auf Herz und Nieren und führst einfache Kontenabstimmungen durch. Finance-Support: Du unterstützt uns tatkräftig bei betriebswirtschaftlichen Auswertungen und übernimmst administrative Aufgaben im Finanzbereich. Qualifikation Dein Fundament: Du bist eingeschriebene*r Student*in, idealerweise im Bereich Wirtschaftswissenschaften, BWL, Finance & Accounting oder einem vergleichbaren Studiengang mit Zahlenfokus. Deine Motivation: Erneuerbare Energien und Zukunftsmodelle bringen Dich in Fahrt und geben Dir einen Grund, morgens aufzustehen. Dein Mindset: Du hast eine ausgeprägte Affinität zu Zahlen, arbeitest extrem präzise, strukturiert und absolut zuverlässig. Deine Tools: MS Office (insbesondere Excel) ist für Dich kein Fremdwort, und Du hast Lust, Dich schnell in moderne Buchhaltungstools einzuarbeiten. Datev Kenntnisse sind von Vorteil, aber kein Muss. Sprache: Du sprichst verhandlungssicheres Deutsch (C2) und kannst Dich auch auf Englisch (B2) gut ausdrücken. Benefits Flache Hierarchien & offene Unternehmenskultur: Deine Meinung zählt – wir schätzen Deine Expertise und Ideen. Top Lage in Köln: Unser Büro liegt zentral, ist hervorragend erreichbar und umgeben von kulinarischer Vielfalt. Ein starkes Team: Von Tag eins an wirst Du Dich willkommen fühlen – wir leben ein familiäres und wertschätzendes Miteinander. Weiterentwicklung & Perspektive: Wir fördern Deine persönliche und fachliche Entwicklung und bieten Dir langfristige Wachstumsmöglichkeiten (z. B. für Deine Abschlussarbeit oder einen späteren Festeinstieg). Flexibles Arbeiten: Ob im Büro oder mal von zu Hause – wir bieten Dir Flexibilität, wo es möglich ist, damit sich Job und Studium perfekt vereinbaren lassen. Moderne Ausstattung: Ein ergonomischer Arbeitsplatz und moderne Tools unterstützen Dich bei Deiner täglichen Arbeit. title: IT Consultant Versicherungsbranche (w/m/d)
description: KARRIERE BEI COGNITIVO Gestalte mit uns die digitale Zukunft der Versicherungsbranche. Die Versicherungsbranche verändert sich grundlegend. Neue digitale Geschäftsmodelle, steigende Kundenanforderungen und die kontinuierliche Modernisierung von Prozessen und IT-Systemen stellen Versicherungsunternehmen vor neue Herausforderungen. Wir bei cognitivo begleiten namhafte Versicherungen bei diesem Wandel. Dafür suchen wir Dich: eine Beraterpersönlichkeit, die fachliche Tiefe mit echtem Gestaltungswillen verbindet und Lust hat, digitale Lösungen nicht nur zu denken, sondern umzusetzen. Aufgaben Du berätst unsere Kunden bei der Analyse, Optimierung und Digitalisierung ihrer Geschäftsprozesse und entwickelst gemeinsam mit ihnen Lösungen, die fachlich überzeugen und technisch funktionieren. Von der ersten Anforderungsanalyse bis zur erfolgreichen Umsetzung begleitest Du Projekte end-to-end und bist dabei eine zentrale Ansprechperson, die den Überblick behält und Themen ins Ziel bringt. Im Projektalltag analysierst Du komplexe Geschäftsprozesse, identifizierst Digitalisierungspotenziale und entwickelst gemeinsam mit unseren Kunden fachliche und technische Lösungskonzepte. Du übersetzt Anforderungen in Fachkonzepte, User Stories und Prozessmodelle, moderierst Workshops und Abstimmungen und bringst unterschiedliche Stakeholder zusammen Qualifikation Du hast ein Studium in (Wirtschafts-)Informatik, BWL, Mathematik, Wirtschaftswissenschaften oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation abgeschlossen und bereits als IT Consultant, Business Analyst, Requirements Engineer oder Business Consultant gearbeitet. Idealerweise bringst Du Erfahrung in der Versicherungsbranche mit und kennst die Geschäftsprozesse und IT-Systeme von Versicherungsunternehmen. Was uns darüber hinaus wichtig ist: Du kannst komplexe Themen analytisch erfassen, verständlich strukturieren und in praxisnahe Lösungen übersetzen. Du arbeitest selbstständig, strukturiert und lösungsorientiert und hast Freude daran, Verantwortung für eigene Themen zu übernehmen. Gleichzeitig überzeugst Du durch Deine Kommunikations- und Moderationsstärke und fühlst Dich im Austausch mit unterschiedlichen Stakeholdern sicher. Du interessierst Dich für digitale Transformation und innovative Technologien und hast die Bereitschaft, für Projekteinsätze regelmäßig zu unseren Kunden zu reisen. Sehr gute Deutsch- und gute Englischkenntnisse setzen wir voraus. Benefits Spannende Projekte : Anspruchsvolle Digitalisierungs- und Transformationsprojekte bei führenden Versicherungsunternehmen. Gestaltungsspielraum : Verantwortung für eigene Themen und die Möglichkeit, deine Ideen direkt einzubringen. Kundenkontakt : Direkte Zusammenarbeit mit Fachbereichen und Entscheidern auf Augenhöhe. Kundennähe : Arbeiten beim Kunden, in einer unserer Niederlassungen oder zeitweise remote – passend zum Projekt. Entwicklung : Individuelle Weiterbildungs- und Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten zur gezielten Förderung deiner fachlichen Entwicklung. Team : Flache Hierarchien, kurze Entscheidungswege und ein Umfeld, in dem Wissen geteilt und Zusammenarbeit gelebt wird. Benefits : Unbefristeter Arbeitsvertrag, attraktive Vergütung, 30 Urlaubstage mit steigender Anzahl bei längerer Betriebszugehörigkeit sowie arbeitsfreie Tage an Heiligabend und Silvester. Weitere Benefits wie Edenred-Karte, JobRad und betriebliche Altersvorsorge runden unser Angebot ab. Warum cognitivo? „Big enough to deliver and small enough to care.“ Als spezialisierte Unternehmensberatung für die Finanz- und Versicherungsbranche begleiten wir namhafte Unternehmen seit fast zwei Jahrzehnten bei der Modernisierung ihrer IT und der Entwicklung zukunftsfähiger Lösungen. Mit rund 35 erfahrenen Beraterinnen und Beratern, über 50 erfolgreich abgeschlossenen Projekten und tiefem Domänenwissen in Versicherung, Payment, IT-Transformation und strategischen Innovationen schaffen wir Lösungen mit messbarem Mehrwert – und ein Arbeitsumfeld, in dem Eigeninitiative, Teamgeist und gute Zusammenarbeit zählen. Lust auf den nächsten Schritt? Wenn du abwechslungsreiche Projekte, direkten Kundenkontakt und moderne Digitalisierungsthemen suchst, freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung! title: Supply Chain Program Manager - Rack Integration
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><p><strong>About the Department</strong></p> <p>The Infrastructure Engineering team builds and scales Cloudflare’s global network, ensuring high availability, security, and performance across hundreds of cities worldwide. Within Infrastructure Engineering, the Hardware Integration Operations team acts as the critical bridge connecting our global manufacturing partners, procurement teams, and capacity strategy. We manage the end-to-end flow of server and network hardware into fully integrated data center racks to support our growing global network. By working closely with external manufacturing partners and cross-functional teams, we ensure the infrastructure powering the internet is built, tested, and deployed efficiently, securely, and resiliently.</p> <p><strong>About the Role</strong></p> <p>As a Senior Supply Chain Program Manager, you will own the integrated supply-planning interface connecting capacity demand, L10 hardware supply, and L11 rack integration. In this senior individual contributor role, you will coordinate the transition of servers and network equipment from server-level manufacturing (L10) into complete rack integration (L11), providing global partners with the material readiness, capacity planning, and operational visibility needed to execute Cloudflare’s global expansion.</p> <p><strong>What You’ll Do</strong></p> <ul> <li> <p><strong>Drive Strategic Supply Planning:</strong> Connect capacity requirements with L10 hardware availability and L11 rack manufacturing schedules to maintain scalable supply plans across global regions.</p> </li> <li> <p><strong>Manage Material & Production Readiness:</strong> Oversee weekly supply allocation reporting, shortage reviews, and material-readiness assessments for upcoming rack integration builds.</p> </li> <li> <p><strong>Guide Operational Tradeoffs:</strong> Identify supply constraints and present actionable allocation options to Capacity Planning, evaluating tradeoffs between direct hardware shipping and complete rack integration.</p> </li> <li> <p><strong>Translate Long-Term Strategy:</strong> Convert quarterly and annual capacity forecasts into actionable operational requirements for L11 integration partners.</p> </li> <li> <p><strong>Monitor Program Financials & Progress:</strong> Track CapEx commitments against rack integration and deployment plans, giving leadership visibility into utilization, execution progress, and delivery risks.</p> </li> <li> <p><strong>Lead Supplier Relationships:</strong> Partner with global L11 integration providers through regular business reviews covering capacity, delivery, cost, quality, and performance.</p> </li> <li> <p><strong>Expand Resilient Manufacturing:</strong> Evaluate and recommend new L11 suppliers and build locations to strengthen geographic resiliency, capacity growth, and technical standards.</p> </li> <li> <p><strong>Support Commercial Operations:</strong> Validate supplier requisitions, purchase orders, and commercial agreements while supporting leadership approval workflows.</p> </li> <li> <p><strong>Partner on Global Supply Risk Mitigation:</strong> Collaborate with Capacity Planning, Procurement, and Hardware Sourcing to identify and mitigate rack integration risks involving capacity bottlenecks, logistics hurdles, tariffs, and regional concentration.</p> </li> <li> <p><strong>Partner on New Product Introductions (NPI):</strong> Collaborate with Hardware Engineering and rack integration teams to translate evolving hardware designs into operational preproduction and build readiness plans.</p> </li> <li> <p><strong>Support Supplier Quality: </strong>Analyze supplier-performance trends, coordinate escalations, and track cross-functional quality and engineering issues through resolution.</p> </li> <li> <p><strong>Operationalize ERP Workflows: </strong>Support adoption and stabilization of the team’s Oracle ERP processes, then identify improvements to planning, reporting, controls, and operational efficiency.</p> </li> <li> <p><strong>Deliver Executive Insights:</strong> Create clear forecasts, operational reporting, and risk assessments for leadership review.</p> </li> <li> <p><strong>Scale the Operating Model:</strong> Establish sustainable operational frameworks that expand production capacity while maximizing efficiency.</p> </li> </ul> <p><strong>Required Qualifications</strong></p> <ul> <li> <p>Broad professional experience in global supply chain management, production planning, manufacturing operations, or a related field.</p> </li> <li> <p>Proven track record coordinating supply and production programs across multi-site manufacturing environments and international regions.</p> </li> <li> <p>Demonstrated skill in connecting demand forecasts, material readiness, supplier capacity, and manufacturing schedules.</p> </li> <li> <p>Experience independently leading complex, cross-functional programs across engineering, procurement, finance, and external vendors.</p> </li> <li> <p>Strong analytical skills with expertise in supply modeling, risk assessment, and operational reporting.</p> </li> <li> <p>Demonstrated capability to manage supplier performance and lead business reviews at both operational and executive levels.</p> </li> <li> <p>Strong written and verbal communication skills, with experience presenting strategic options and risks to leadership.</p> </li> <li> <p>Ability to collaborate effectively across global time zones.</p> </li> </ul> <p><strong>Desirable / Preferred Qualifications</strong></p> <ul> <li> <p>Experience with contract manufacturing (CM), original design manufacturers (ODM), or systems integrators for data center, server, or network hardware.</p> </li> <li> <p>Experience managing, optimizing, or stabilizing supply chain processes within an enterprise ERP platform (preferably Oracle).</p> </li> <li> <p>Experience evaluating manufacturing partners, leading supplier assessments, or managing RFP processes.</p> </li> <li> <p>Background in supporting commercial negotiations, procurement agreements, and supplier capacity commitments.</p> </li> <li> <p>Familiarity with hardware new product introduction (NPI) and manufacturing transition processes.</p> </li> <li> <p>Knowledge of global supply risk management, including tariff mitigation, logistics planning, and regional diversification.</p> </li> <li> <p>Experience using performance scorecards and operational metrics to drive supplier accountability.</p> </li> <li> <p>Willingness to travel occasionally for supplier site visits and operational reviews.</p> </li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.</span></p> <p><a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/protecting-free-expression-online/"><strong>Project Galileo</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.</span></p> <p><strong><a href="https://www.cloudflare.com/athenian/">Athenian Project</a></strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.</span></p> <p><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"><strong>1.1.1.1</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: We released</span><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"> <span style="font-weight: 400;">1.1.1.1</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our</span><a href="https://developers.cloudflare.com/1.1.1.1/privacy/public-dns-resolver"> privacy commitment</a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs.  More details about this

description: Unsere Standorte Wir suchen dich für unser Vertriebsteam in der Schweiz an unserem Standort in Liebefeld bei Bern Dein zukünftiges Team Bei Meierhofer treiben wir die Digitalisierung von Spitälern, Reha und psychiatrischen Kliniken voran. title: Lead Software Engineer (m/f/d)
description: These tasks are waiting for you Take technical ownership of Configuration Experience — the team that builds and manages our insurance products — and set the direction for how the team delivers. Spend the bulk of your time hands-on: researching technical solutions, writing RFCs, building PoCs with other teams, and shipping the resulting code yourself. Act as a sparring partner for product managers and stakeholders on key business and technical decisions. Keep delivery on track — plan realistically, follow agile principles, hit deadlines. Lead people by example: give feedback, run team meetings, support colleagues' growth. This is a smaller part of the role — most of your time stays technical. Spot obstacles early, resolve them, and keep stakeholders proactively informed. This is what you bring to the table You don't need to tick every box. If this sounds like your kind of work, we want to hear from you. Solid hands-on experience as a software engineer with Node.js and TypeScript. First experience leading or managing people — you don't need years of management under your belt, but you've done it at least once and want to grow into it further. Full-stack understanding across frontend and backend, with a cloud-agnostic mindset. Solid experience working with AI tools in your engineering workflow — Harnesses, delegating tasks to subagents, orchestrating multi-agent setups, and similar. Clear communicator, motivated to grow into building and guiding a team over time. Insurance or finance experience is a plus. What we offer Together with our investor, AXA, we offer a combination of entrepreneurial freedom, leading technological know-how, reliability and extensive experience in the conception and management of insurance solutions that is rather unusual for the insurance industry. When you become part of our team, you can expect to work with incredibly versatile and talented colleagues. The opportunity to lead and grow an exciting team The opportunity to shape the future of insurance by contributing to the strategy and success of Alteos and further advancing one of the worlds leading core insurance systems Modern working in the middle of Berlin's City-West, with a wide range of perks and benefits. To name a few: subsidized lunch & one free lunch a week, discount on BVG ticket, company (e-)bike leasing, urban sports club, mental well-being app Many opportunities to connect with your colleagues outside of daily work, e.g.through team events, weekly yoga classes, team runs and more A flexible work model (hybrid working role) Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Integrated Photonics Packaging Engineer (m/f/d)
description: Your mission The future of AI computing is light, not electrons. As Senior Integrated Photonics Packaging Engineer , you will sit at the very heart of Q.ANT’s photonic hardware R&D. You will research, develop, and demonstrate novel electrical and optical packaging concepts that bring our photonic integrated circuits (PICs) to their full performance potential. Rather than managing external suppliers to deliver off-the-shelf solutions, you will own the hands-on development of packaging architectures end-to-end - from first-principles design through prototyping, benchtop characterization, and validation. By bridging optical, electrical, and thermal domains, you will directly shape the performance, integrability, and scalability of our PIC-based systems. At Q.ANT, we are building photonic processing systems that compute with light - delivering a scalable, energy-efficient alternative to transistor-based architectures for next-generation AI and high-performance computing. Your Impact & Responsibilities Drive Packaging Innovation: Conceive, build, and experimentally validate novel packaging prototypes and assembly methods for the co-integration of PICs with light sources, photodetectors, and high-speed analog electronics. Lead Workstreams End-to-End: Lead packaging R&D workstreams from concept definition and experiment design to hands-on benchtop testing and documented knowledge transfer. Solve First-Principles Engineering Challenges: Define packaging requirements and solve complex optical coupling, RF/microwave signal integrity, and thermal management challenges from a first-principles understanding. Develop Coupling Schemes: Design, build, and measure advanced optical coupling schemes (e.g., edge coupling, grating coupling, lensed fiber, micro-lens arrays). Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner closely with PIC designers, systems engineers, and electronics teams to ensure packaging architectures are co-designed with device- and system-level constraints in mind. Build Institutional Knowledge: Document process recipes, assembly procedures, design rules, and tolerance budgets to enable manufacturability assessments, repeatability, and IP generation. Technical Supplier Alignment: Coordinate with external partners and suppliers for specialized materials or fabrication capabilities as the technical lead who specifies and validates rather than manages delivery. Mentorship & Leadership: Mentor junior engineers and contribute to shaping the team’s overall packaging R&D roadmap. Your profile Education: Master’s or Ph.D. in Photonics, Optoelectronics, Electrical Engineering, Physics, or a related field (a Ph.D. with an experimental packaging or integration focus is strongly preferred). Hands-on Experience: 5+ years of hands-on R&D experience in photonic/optoelectronic packaging, hybrid integration, or high-density interconnect development within a research institution, deep-tech startup, or advanced R&D environment. Prototyping & Co-Integration Track Record: Proven experience conceiving, building, and characterizing novel packaging prototypes-specifically co-integrating PICs, laser sources/SOAs, photodetectors, and high-speed analog electronics. Technical Depth: Deep understanding of optical alignment/coupling methods, flip-chip/wire bonding, die attach, hermetic encapsulation, RF signal integrity, and thermal management. Lab & Tool Proficiency: Hands-on proficiency with optical characterization (insertion loss, far-field imaging, OLCR/OFDR, LIV testing) and electrical characterization tools (VNA, high-speed oscilloscopes). Familiarity with CAD layout tools and optical simulation software (e.g., Zemax , Lumerical ) is a plus. Mindset & Ownership: High degree of autonomy and creative problem-solving skills to navigate complex, competing constraints without off-the-shelf solutions. Strong self-leadership and collaboration skills. Languages: Fluent in English; knowledge of German or another European language is a plus. Why us? Work on the leading edge: Photonic AI acceleration technologies that will define the next decade of computing - already validated in production HPC environments. Make impact at scale: Help solve one of computing's biggest challenges - making growing demand in compute and sustainability go hand in hand. Own your work from day one: Broad autonomy and decision authority with direct impact on product success, packaging baselines, and overall PIC module quality. Fast-track your growth: Work on challenges with few industry precedents - every problem you solve becomes new institutional knowledge and potentially industry-defining IP. World-class team: Collaborate alongside a passionate, international, cross-functional team of experts in photonics, processor design, and AI systems. Direct access to leadership: Work closely with the company's leaders within a transparent and fast-moving structure. Collaborative culture: Innovative work environment that values technical excellence, open communication, and pragmatic problem-solving. Be part of history: Join at the inflection point where photonic computing transitions from research to mainstream—your contributions will shape this transformation. title: Director of rewards, data & analytics
description: Hi, we’re Back Market. We’re here to help make tech reliable, affordable, and better than new . We're a global marketplace for refurbished devices, helping lower our collective environmental impact by providing trustworthy, affordable tech with 92% less carbon emissions than new. Yep, you read that right. Turns out refurbished tech is way better for the planet than new. In fact, With every device purchased on Back Market, our positive impact on the planet grows. From our Customer Care representatives to our software engineer, every individual at Back Market cuts the planet — and consumers — a break. Our mission is simple: to do more with what we already have. Are you ready to join us? As Director, Rewards & Data, you make pay, equity, benefits, workforce costs and People data work as one decision system You join the People Leadership Team and lead a team of three experts (Compensation; People Data & HR Cockpit; Cost Control & Workforce Planning), plus our Benefits and Immigration providers. Your mandate has two sides: Total Rewards — design and run a reward system (compensation, stock options and BSPCE, benefits, international mobility) that is competitive, fair, transparent and financially sustainable. People data and workforce economics — give leadership a reliable, shared view of headcount, people costs and workforce trends, and turn it into recommendations before decisions are made. What you'll do Build and lead the hub Set the hub's vision, roadmap and ways of working; lead and grow your three experts and manage specialist providers with clear accountability. Define who decides what with People Partners, Finance, Legal, Payroll and People Operations & Tech, and shape our People strategy as a member of the People Leadership Team. Own Total Rewards and compensation Own our reward philosophy and global compensation framework: job architecture, salary ranges, benchmarking and pay positioning. Lead the annual compensation review with Finance, and advise executives and People Partners on offers, promotions, retention and organisational changes. Monitor internal equity and market competitiveness, and get Back Market ready for the EU Pay Transparency Directive. Steer our equity programmes (stock options and BSPCE) Own equity principles, governance and the role of equity in total compensation, with Finance and Legal. Guarantee a reliable, documented and auditable lifecycle from grant to exit, and help employees understand and value their equity. Turn People data into decisions Own the HR Cockpit priorities and the definition of our key People metrics, built on Workday and aligned with company data standards. Co-steer workforce planning and the people cost trajectory with Finance (headcount, compensation, equity, benefits, contingent workers), with scenarios for organisational decisions. Shape benefits and international mobility Set the principles for global and local benefits and immigration, and manage providers on compliance, quality, cost and employee experience as we grow internationally. Keep it trustworthy Make sure reward decisions and sensitive data are handled with clear governance, approvals, auditability and data protection, and flag reward-related risks early. What you'll bring Significant experience leading a Total Rewards or Comp & Ben function in an international, multi-site company. Scale-up, tech or marketplace experience is a strong plus. Hands-on ownership of stock option and BSPCE programmes (or comparable French equity plans): governance, allocation and lifecycle. A track record of running people cost and headcount planning with Finance, and of building or rebuilding an HR data or analytics capability. Multi-country practice across Europe and at least one of the US or APAC, with working knowledge of pay transparency and pay equity requirements. Credibility with a CEO, a CFO and an Executive Committee: you bring fact-based recommendations and challenge constructively. Sound judgement balancing fairness, business needs, market competitiveness and financial sustainability. A builder mindset: you enjoy shaping a hub that is still taking form with a lean team, and you stay close enough to the detail to guarantee quality. The ability to explain complex reward and equity topics simply, and to handle sensitive matters with discretion. Fluent English (our working language). WHY SHOULD YOU JOIN US ? ✌🏼 At Back Market, we’re committed to hiring and supporting diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives — it’s one of the reasons we’re such a high-scoring certified B Corp company (93.2). No matter your role and seniority level, you’ll enjoy impact-driven work with hands-on career development in an innovative, driven, and fast-paced environment — with benefits to match, like: - A mission driven work environment where your day to day makes an impact on the planet. Seriously. - Hybrid work environment, with 2 remote days a week and 1 remote work week per quarter, plus 3 flex days. - Employee Resource Groups, including mentorship programs, comprehensive accessibility policies, and cultural competency training. At Back Market, we strive to create a workplace that embodies the world we’re trying to change. We’ve embedded our diversity, equity, and inclusion principles into our DNA — from dedicated staff to employee resource groups to our company values. We know that the perfect background for a role doesn’t mean the perfect fit — we encourage you to apply for a role even if you think you may not have all the qualifications. If reasonable accommodations are needed for the interview process, please do not hesitate to discuss this with the Talent Acquisition Team. Find more English Speaking Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

streamline repetitive workflows.</p><p><strong>Key Responsibilities</strong></p><h3><strong>Engineering & Quality Review</strong></h3><ul><li><p><strong>Ensure BOM Accuracy:</strong> Review and validate complex BOMs prior to release to integration partners, proactively identifying part substitutions, spec mismatches, and potential build blockers.</p></li><li><p><strong>Bridge Engineering & Production:</strong> Partner closely with hardware design engineers to resolve design change requests (DCRs) and BOM discrepancies throughout the build lifecycle.</p></li><li><p><strong>Maintain Technical Quality Standards:</strong> Leverage functional expertise across rack-level power, networking, server, and firmware architectures to evaluate build compliance against Cloudflare specifications.</p></li></ul><h3><strong>Materials & Logistics Operations</strong></h3><ul><li><p><strong>Support Materials Planning:</strong> Contribute to demand forecasting and materials planning defects.</p></li><li><p><strong>Maintain Program Visibility:</strong> Track hardware build cycles in Jira, leading documentation, status check-ins, and project closeouts alongside cross-functional quality trends using AI-assisted analysis tools to surface actionable operational insights.</p></li><li><p><strong>Build Shared Tooling:</strong> Develop, document, and maintain sustainable, lightweight automation scripts and workflows for adoption across the broader team.</p></li></ul><p><strong>Qualifications</strong></p><h3><strong>Requirements</strong></h3><ul><li><p><strong>Vendor & procurement, supply chain, and external partner teams.</p></li></ul><h3><strong>Desirable / Bonus Qualifications</strong></h3><ul><li><p>Background in data center infrastructure hardware (servers, title: Engineering Manager, Browser Run
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><p><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><strong>Available Locations: Lisbon</strong></span></p> <h2><span style="font-size: 12pt;">About the Department</span></h2> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Emerging Technologies & Incubation (ETI) is where new and bold products are built and released within Cloudflare. It runs full browser sessions on Cloudflare’s global network and lets developers drive them with code or with an agent: a Chrome DevTools Protocol endpoint that any Puppeteer, Playwright or CDP client can connect to from anywhere, Workers bindings, and a REST API for the common jobs — screenshots, PDFs, Markdown extraction, scraping and crawling. It is also a billed product on a steep growth curve, which makes capacity, cold-start latency, concurrency limits and abuse protection product problems rather than merely operational ones.</span></p> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;">The team’s wider portfolio includes an agent-first browser built on Workers rather than containers, a managed CI platform for the agent development lifecycle, visual regression testing delivered as a service, a pre-rendering service, URL Scanner, and CDNJS. Browser Run is the focus of this role today; there is scope for more of that portfolio to come into it as the role and the team grow.</span></p> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Browser Run went from an internal rendering tool to a public, billed product, and the surface has not stopped moving — the CDP endpoint, MCP client support, session replay and the REST API all landed inside a year. That pace is the point, and it is the thing this role has to make sustainable.</span></p> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;">We are a tight-knit team that communicates and collaborates regularly. We celebrate our achievements, support each other when we make mistakes, and hold each other and our work to the highest standard.</span></p> <p> </p> <h2><span style="font-size: 12pt;">About the Role</span></h2> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;">This is a hands-on engineering management role. You will own Browser Run engineering end to end — the people, the roadmap, the reliability, and the story we tell customers about it. You will report to the Senior Engineering Manager for AI Agents Tooling & Platform and partner closely with Product Management, Developer Relations, and platform teams across Cloudflare.</span></p> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Browser Run is the primary focus. The team owns other products, and there is scope for some of them to move into your remit as the role and the team grow, but we are hiring someone to make Browser Run excellent first.</span></p> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;">You will not be writing most of the code. External developers and other Cloudflare teams depend on this service.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Keep the automation surface honest: Puppeteer and Playwright compatibility, CDP behaviour that matches what developers expect from a local Chrome, and a credible story for Chrome version upgrades.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Develop leaders. Identify and grow the engineers who will run day-to-day delivery for an area of the product, and hand that work to them.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Resolve cross-team dependencies with the Workers, Developer Platform, Security and Billing teams, and bring contentious technical decisions to closure quickly and calmly.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Own the commercial mechanics of a billed service, including the unglamorous parts: usage metering, quotas, plan limits, abuse protection and pricing input.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Represent Browser Run externally through launch blog posts, developer documentation, conference talks and direct customer conversations.</span></li> </ul> <p> </p> <h2><span style="font-size: 12pt;">About you</span></h2> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;">We want you to love it here. title: Computer Vision & AI Engineer - Interceptor C‑UAS (m/f/d)
description: About the role: At Quantum Systems, we are building highly autonomous interceptor systems that must perceive, decide, and act under extreme latency, motion, and environmental constraints. We are looking for a Computer Vision & AI Engineer to drive the perception stack of our Counter-UAS interceptor platform. You will work on low-latency camera pipelines, small-object detection, object tracking, sensor fusion, visual odometry, precision landing, camera calibration, embedded inference, and data pipelines for training and validation. This role is suited for someone with a strong academic or practical background in computer vision, AI, robotics, or perception systems. A Master’s degree is expected; a PhD is a strong plus. We are open to ambitious early-career candidates if they bring strong technical depth, practical implementation skills, and the ability to own complex perception problems. Your Mission You will develop the vision and AI pipeline that turns raw camera data into actionable perception outputs for autonomous flight. This includes low-latency detection and tracking, motion-aware vision, sensor fusion with inertial data, 3D direction-vector estimation, GPS-denied navigation, and precision landing support. What is your Day to Day Mission: Bring up, optimize, and maintain high-performance camera pipelines, including CSI camera interfaces, raw image access, buffering, synchronization, and latency reduction. Develop detection algorithms for small and difficult-to-see objects in moving and rotating camera images. Combine machine learning and classical computer vision approaches where appropriate. Fuse inertial data, motion information, and visual data to improve detection and tracking in moving image sequences. Build object tracking pipelines that can switch from initial detection to low-latency tracking once a target has been acquired. Optimize perception pipelines for embedded execution on NVIDIA Jetson platforms. Work toward high frame-rate processing targets in the range of 100–300 FPS, where technically feasible. Use camera intrinsics and extrinsics to transform image-space detections into 3D direction vectors or other navigation-relevant outputs. Work on GPS-denied navigation concepts using visual odometry, including approaches with forward-facing camera views rather than only downward-looking cameras. Develop visual support for precision landing, including height estimation, velocity estimation, and motion-state estimation from limited camera perspectives. Build and maintain the data pipeline from onboard recordings to cloud storage, preprocessing, annotation, dataset generation, training, validation, and benchmarking. Work with annotation tools such as SuperAnnotate, CVAT, Label Studio, or comparable systems. Benchmark and evaluate different model and algorithm families, including approaches such as CenterNet, SuperPoint, SuperGlue, optical flow, feature tracking, object detection, and lightweight embedded models. Build deployment pipelines using ONNX, TensorRT, custom inference runners, or comparable embedded inference tooling. Collaborate closely with autonomy, flight control, embedded software, test, and systems engineering teams. What you bring to the team: Master’s degree or PhD in computer vision, AI, robotics, machine learning, electrical engineering, computer science, aerospace engineering, or a comparable technical field. Strong understanding of computer vision fundamentals, camera geometry, feature detection, object detection, tracking, calibration, and image-space to 3D transformations. Practical experience implementing computer vision or machine learning pipelines in Python and C++ . Experience with embedded inference, ideally on NVIDIA Jetson , CUDA, TensorRT, ONNX, GStreamer, V4L2, or similar technologies. Ability to read, understand, and implement ideas from current research papers. Understanding of latency, throughput, profiling, memory movement, and real-time constraints. Experience with dataset creation, annotation workflows, training/validation splits, metrics, and benchmarking. Strong mathematical intuition and willingness to debug both algorithms and real-world sensor data. Ability to take ownership of a technical area and drive it from research prototype to flight-test-ready software. Experience with UAV perception, robotics perception, visual odometry, SLAM, sensor fusion, or tracking systems. Experience with IMU-camera fusion, ego-motion compensation, rolling-shutter effects, or high-frame-rate cameras. Experience with precision landing, visual navigation, or GPS-denied navigation. Experience building cloud-based ML training and validation pipelines. Publications, thesis work, GitHub projects, demos, or competition results in computer vision, robotics, AI, or autonomous systems. Note: We operate in an industry where women, as well as other minority groups, are systematically under-represented. We encourage you to apply even if you dont meet all the listed qualifications; ability and impact cannot be summarised in a few bullet points. Why Quantum-Systems: Be at the forefront of next-generation Defence innovation . Work in a fast-paced, agile environment where your ideas make an impact. Collaborate with a team of industry pioneers who are ambitious, bold, and visionary. Opportunities for individual and professional growth in a globally recognized organization. Our benefits: Company pension scheme: We support you so that you can already make provisions for later. Flexible working hours: With trust-based working hours, you are not only responsible for your working hours, but also for your work-life balance. Mobile Work: If things get a little busy in the office, you have the option to work remotely one flexible day per week to create the right balance. Stay active: With EGYM Wellpass, you get access to thousands of fitness and sports facilities — and of course, we subsidize the membership. Bike-Leasing: We support you in staying environmentally mobile and healthy. Corporate Benefits: Your opportunity for attractive offers and discounts from well-known suppliers and brands, e.g. Adidas, Apple, Expedia. Employee events: We not only want to grow together, but also celebrate our successes together. Lunch-Card: Be powerful with delicious energy, daily lunch budget is sponsored. Company Shuttle: Enjoy our convenient shuttle service that picks you up from Laim in Munich and brings you to our location, with return trips at the end of the workday. About us: Quantum Systems is a leading European deep-tech company for unmanned systems across air, land and maritime domains. We develop and scale integrated hardware, software and AI-powered solutions for mission-critical operations. By combining autonomous platforms with intelligent software and AI, Quantum Systems enables customers to operate, understand and act across domains. title: Senior Engineering Manager - Workers KV
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><h3><strong>Available Locations: Lisbon | London | Hybrid</strong></h3> <h3 id="JD:EngineeringManagerWorkersKV-AbouttheDepartment"><strong>About the Department</strong></h3> <p>Emerging Technologies & Incubation (ETI) is where new and bold products are built and released within Cloudflare. Rather than being constrained by the structures which make Cloudflare a massively successful business, we are able to leverage them to deliver entirely new tools and products to our customers. Cloudflare’s edge and network make it possible to solve problems at massive scale and efficiency which would be impossible for almost any other organization.</p> <h3 id="JD:EngineeringManagerWorkersKV-AbouttheTeam">About the Team</h3> <p>The Workers KV team delivers Cloudflare's global, low-latency, key-value data storage. KV lets developers store and retrieve data globally. With Workers KV, you can build dynamic and performant APIs and websites that support high read volumes with low latency.</p> <p>KV is integrated with Cloudflare Workers but can also be used via our REST API. Here are a few example use-cases:</p> <ul> <li><strong>Caching API responses</strong></li> <li><strong>Storing user configurations and preferences</strong></li> <li><strong>Storing user authentication details</strong></li> </ul> <p>The team is geographically distributed across Western Europe.</p> <h3 id="JD:EngineeringManagerWorkersKV-Whatyou'lldo"><strong>What you'll do</strong></h3> <p>We are looking for an experienced Senior Engineering Manager to join our team. You will work with a team of passionate, talented engineers that are building innovative products that bring security and speed to millions of internet users each day. You will play an active part in shaping product features and improving performance to make Workers KV the best it can be. You will make sure our company hits our ambitious goals from an engineering standpoint. You will change the way people build applications.</p> <p>You bring a passion for meeting business needs by building technical, innovative solutions. You excel to understand how big-picture goals inform technical details. You thrive in a fast-paced iterative engineering environment and have experience in delivering scalable distributed systems. You coordinate closely with Product, Tech, Sales, and Marketing across markets, following up on commitments and ensuring cross-functional initiatives stay on track. You constantly look for ways to improve how the Go-to-Market function operates, bringing structure and rigour to a fast-moving, scaling environment. Your profile You bring at least 3 to 5 years of experience in a Chief of Staff, business operations, analyst, or similar high-rigour role, ideally within tech, scale-ups, or energy. You have strong project management skills, able to build the architecture and structure that keeps complex, multi-market projects on track. You are highly structured and organised by default, able to juggle multiple workstreams and deadlines without losing the thread. You are strong with data and analytics, comfortable turning numbers into clear, actionable insight. Als Europas führender Hosting-Anbieter und Pionier für unabhängige Cloud-Lösungen bauen wir eine Infrastruktur der nächsten Generation: von souveränen Cloud-Architekturen und hochperformanten GPU-Clustern bis hin zu integrierten KI-Automatisierungstools. Was uns antreibt: Digitale Entscheidungsfreiheit für Europa und echter Impact für kleine und mittlere Unternehmen (KMU) sowie Großunternehmen. Wir arbeiten in agilen Teams, setzen auf transparente Strukturen und glauben daran, dass Exzellenz und Innovation nur mit echtem Teamgeist entstehen. Bereit für Deinen nächsten Schritt? Werde ein Teil von IONOS und wachse mit uns. Wir entwickeln und betreiben die Hosting Communication Platform (HCP) und bauen aktuell den neuen Marketing Hub für die gesamte IONOS Gruppe auf. Unser mikrosystembasiertes Netzwerk bereitet Kundenkommunikation auf, generiert sie und liefert sie über E-Mail, SMS, Push-Nachrichten und Briefe aus. Als produktfokussiertes Team verantworten wir die Weiterentwicklung der Plattform, den Rollout über alle IONOS-Marken hinweg sowie die Bereitstellung unseres neuen Marketing-Hub-Ökosystems. Aufgabenbereich Du entwickelst robuste Backend-Services in Java mit Spring Boot und bist maßgeblich daran beteiligt, unsere Plattform weiterzuentwickeln und für neue Marken auszurollen. Du arbeitest eng mit anderen Entwicklungsteams zusammen und bringst neue Ideen pragmatisch in die Umsetzung. Du unterstützt beim technischen Design, Review-Prozessen und hilfst mit deiner Erfahrung, unsere Plattform stabil und performant zu halten. Du besitzt Wissen in Frontend-Technologien wie React , um unseren Marketing Hub weiter auszubauen. Optional: Du hast Erfahrung in PHP? Unser Kommunikations-Editor ist aktuell PHP-basiert. Parallel arbeiten wir an neuen Modulen rund um unseren Marketing Hub in React. Qualifikationen Du hast fundierte Erfahrung in der Entwicklung mit Java und Spring Boot und fühlst dich in der Welt von APIs, verteilten Systemen und Microservices zuhause.
