title: Agentic Product Manager
description: About us: Founded by former Google search engineers with PhDs in AI from ETH Zurich, DeepJudge helps legal teams unlock and apply the knowledge inside their organizations through world-class enterprise search and AI infrastructure – enabling them to automate workflows, build knowledge-powered applications, and turn institutional knowledge into a lasting advantage. Every organization can license the same AI models, but no two organizations share the same institutional knowledge. Decades of experience, work product, and precedent are often fragmented across systems, underused, and inaccessible. DeepJudge makes this expertise instantly available and actionable – helping legal teams find the right information faster, surface relevant knowledge, and apply it where it matters most. Our platform is trusted by many of the world’s leading law firms and legal teams, including Holland & Knight, Gunderson Dettmer, Cozen O’Connor, ArentFox Schiff, CMS Switzerland, Schoenherr, and others. Headquartered in Switzerland with a growing team across North America and Europe, DeepJudge is shaping the future of how professional knowledge is discovered and applied. At DeepJudge, we move with urgency, think rigorously, and work closely with our clients to build products that solve meaningful problems. If you want to help define how AI transforms professional knowledge work, we’d love to hear from you. About the role: We’re looking for a hands-on and strategically minded Product Manager to take the reins of our assistant surfaces and agent harness at DeepJudge. You’ll play a critical role in shaping the present and future of our platform by driving immediate impact across our go-to-market priorities while also thinking deeply about where we go next. This is an opportunity to lead product in a high-caliber environment where you're empowered to innovate, move fast, and deliver real value to legal professionals at some of the most sophisticated law firms and legal departments in the world. This is an on-site role based in Zurich. You will report to the Head of Product. We’re not building another AI wrapper. We’re building a product with real depth, differentiated by data access, search engine expertise, and deep customer understanding. Chat is quickly becoming the interface of choice, and we’re now moving towards long-horizon agentic tasks – right at the cutting edge of what’s proven in the market. We’re looking for someone who thrives in ambiguity, is energized by the opportunity to create, and knows how to “cook from scratch” — not just follow the norm . Your responsibilities will include: Own product strategy, roadmap and execution across our Agentic Surfaces and Harness, powering DeepJudge’s advanced AI reasoning features, with a strong focus on prioritization, user impact, and business value Evolve our chat interface to make sure the user experience is the best fit for our target use cases Prioritize feature requests across customers, vertical product areas and new strategic initiatives, balancing short-term go-to-market optimization with long-term discovery and strategic vision Evolve our evaluation datasets and infrastructure to continuously improve our ability to take launch decisions with confidence Assess the speed, quality and cost profile of model or harness changes and drive decision-making across tech and product leadership Proactively identify new technologies and follow the latest agentic AI trends to drive efficiency and performance of complex, long-horizon tasks Work directly with engineering leads to define and ship high-quality features fast Collaborate with Design and Product Marketing to craft delightful and intuitive user experiences Engage deeply with customers and prospects to gather insights, validate ideas, and translate feedback into roadmap priorities – combining direct feedback with scaled usage analysis to understand how our products are used, and sharing those learnings across the organization Lead cross-functional initiatives that drive adoption, engagement, and measurable value for our users Take ownership of product decision-making across our agentic product area You're a great fit if you: Have strong product instincts and 5+ years of experience in digital product management, with a track record of building and launching impactful B2B SaaS products Have hands-on experience building and shipping agentic applications and RAG systems – going beyond basic chatbot or AI workflow features Have a deep understanding of agent evaluation techniques and have built or evolved evaluation datasets and processes before Are familiar with the latest agentic AI trends and concepts – and keep following them Are comfortable leading in a dynamic, fast-paced environment — from writing specs to running discovery calls to shipping fast Think holistically about user problems, systems, and long-term platform value Are humble, curious, and opinionated in the right ways — you seek input but aren’t afraid to take a stand Don’t just follow frameworks or "best practices" — you know when to break them Are energized by having a lot of ownership and working closely with smart, mission-driven teammates Are able to work on-site from our Zurich office Bonus: You have legal domain familiarity, or experience in search and knowledge management, agentic search and data retrieval, or LegalTech – or you’ve worked in/with law firms, legal departments, or regulated industries What you can look forward to: A high-impact role in shaping a product and company with huge potential The chance to work on the cutting edge of long-horizon agentic AI, applied to real-world legal work A strong, technical, and collaborative team that’s serious about building great software A culture that encourages experimentation, curiosity, and thoughtful decision-making Submit your application by October 16th. Our team will review all candidates after the closing date and reach out regarding next steps. At DeepJudge, we believe great teams are built on diverse perspectives and experiences. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and are committed to fostering an inclusive, high-performance culture where everyone can thrive. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds and do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. title: Head of Crypto
description: About us Traditional banking has never really given people control over their financial life. Satispay exists to change that: to empower people through finance . That means making financial services easy and accessible for millions of users. We started with payments, then benefits, investing, cards... and we’re not done. Not even close. Same logic every time: find a real problem, solve it properly, then look for the next one. The destination? To build the most loved financial platform in the world. Getting there takes leaders who own outcomes across teams, not just tasks, and set the tone for refusing the “someone else will fix this” culture. If that's how you lead, you'll fit right in. What you'll be doing As the Head of Crypto, you will be the driving force behind a brand new, core pillar of Satispay's expansion into the cryptocurrency and Web3 space. We already have a high-potential strategy in place—your mission is to take the reins, execute it flawlessly, adapt it when necessary, and expand upon it wherever possible. Given the strategic importance of this initiative to Satispay, you will work with a high degree of autonomy and have direct, frequent touchpoints with the Satispay founding team to align on execution, team scaling, and long-term vision. Here’s what that looks like in practice: Hire & Build Your Team: Identify talent needs, recruit, and structure a dedicated, high-performing cross-functional team from the ground up to bring Satispay's crypto vertical to life. Execution & Strategic Evolution: Take ownership of our existing crypto roadmap. Drive its execution to deliver immediate impact, while continuously evaluating the market to make necessary adjustments and expand our offerings when new opportunities arise. Executive Collaboration: Partner directly with the founders and C-level executives to ensure the crypto rollout continuously aligns with the company's ultimate mission to simplify everyday finance. Product Development: Oversee the end-to-end lifecycle of our crypto products—from infrastructure setup and go-to-market strategy to launch and continuous optimization. Regulatory Navigation: Work in lockstep with the Compliance and Legal teams to ensure all products align perfectly with evolving European regulations (such as MiCA) and safeguarding standards. Strategic Partnerships: Identify and establish crucial relationships with key players in the crypto ecosystem, including exchanges, custodians, liquidity providers, and blockchain networks. You will lead and mentor high-performing teams, collaborate closely with peers with structured communication and transparency, demonstrating a commitment to integrity and ownership. What we're looking for We are seeking for an execution-focused, and product-minded leader with a deep passion for digital assets that matches our company culture. Experience: 7+ years of experience in crypto/Web3 initiatives at a regulated Fintech, exchange, or crypto-native company. Team Building: experience hiring, managing, and scaling specialized, high-performing teams in a fast-paced tech or financial environment. Master of Execution: ability to take a high-level strategy and turn it into shipped products, scaling operations effectively from the ground up. Industry & Market Expertise: Deep, technical understanding of blockchain architecture, crypto market dynamics, digital wallets, custody solutions, and Web3 infrastructure. Regulatory Awareness: Solid knowledge of the European crypto regulatory landscape (e.g., MiCA, AML/KYC for digital assets) and a history of launching products within a strict compliance framework. Strategic Adaptability: Ability to balance bold expansion with stringent risk management Communication & Influence: Excellent ability to align internal and external stakeholders, translating complex crypto concepts into clear, actionable business updates for the founding team. Language Proficiency: You are completely fluent in English. Knowledge of Italian is considered a plus. We recognise that exceptional leadership comes in many forms. If you believe you have the vision, experience, and drive to help us shape the future of money, we encourage you to apply. We value the unique perspectives and strengths that exceptional leaders bring, even if their experience doesn't align with every listed requirement. Why this is your place This is a unique opportunity to leverage your experience and leadership to make a profound impact on a company poised for significant future growth. We operate on a principle of reciprocity: significant strategic impacts are met with meaningful rewards and opportunities. Drive transformative impact. Lead critical functions and initiatives that directly contribute to our mission and impact millions of users and businesses. Operate in high-growth. Thrive in a dynamic, fast-moving environment that demands bravery, resilience, and rapid, decisive action at scale. Experience the excitement of navigating growth where change is constant and the customer base/services are rapidly expanding. Significant equity participation. Directly share in Satispay's success through a competitive Stock Option Plan designed to reward leadership and contribution to company growth and raise the bar for collective success. Lead exceptional teams. Build, mentor, and collaborate with high-performing teams in a culture of ownership, collective success, and continuous improvement fueled by feedback. You will learn from the best and lead alongside founders who are hands-on. CareAbout: how we support your impact We move fast, and evolution never stops. It’s a fun ride, but it can be challenging. To make sure our people truly thrive, we’re committed to making their lives easier, both in the office and out in the world. That’s why we created CareAbout: ❤️ Health: private insurance for you and your family, psychological support with Serenis, mental health workshops. 💰 Financial resources: Stock Option Plan, meal vouchers, relocation support if you’re moving countries. ⚙️ Growth and development: professional development programs, internal mobility, language courses with Preply. 🌱 Flexibility: unlimited PTO, hybrid working policy, flexible working hours. 👨‍👩‍👧 Family: enhanced parental leave, additional leave for child sickness. Equal Opportunity Employer At Satispay, we're proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and inclusion, welcoming individuals of all backgrounds. This opportunity is open to everyone, regardless - for instance - of race, colour, religion, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, and national origin. Join us in a workplace where everyone belongs! Learn more about us Curious what it's actually like here? Our values and pillars shape how we work every day: explore them here . #LI-VR1 #LI-HYBRID By submitting this application, I acknowledge that I have read and understood the content of the Privacy Policy Find Jobs in Switzerland on Arbeitnow

title: Full Stack Software Engineer
description: IN SHORT Are you a versatile problem-solver who wants to write software that impacts the physical world? As a Full Stack Software Engineer (100%) in Zurich, you will be at the core of our operations, building systems that touch everything from warehouse automation to customer-facing smart fridges. YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES Take ownership of warehouse and supplier web apps used daily for inbound processing, picking, labeling, and inventory. Develop and maintain our internal back-office tool, including the backend and GraphQL API that runs menus, deliveries, inventory, and customer sites. Manage the service connecting automated picking lanes to the rest of the system to ensure uninterrupted warehouse operations. Maintain and update the Point of Sale Android app running on hundreds of fridges, managing the release process for the entire fleet. Integrate and support payment systems (Card, TWINT), our ERP, and other partner integrations. Participate in the on-call rotation to debug live issues directly alongside the operations team. Visit the warehouse on-site to test changes and gather feedback from the people actually using the software. Translate vague problems from non-technical colleagues into shipped solutions without needing them broken down first. Own production deployments, managing logs, alerts, and careful rollouts with clear rollback plans. Break down larger features, review other engineers' pull requests, and proactively maintain system health through upgrades, testing, and cleanup. YOUR PROFILE Proven production experience in at least one typed backend language (such as C#, Java, Kotlin, Go, or TypeScript) and one modern frontend framework. Track record of successfully owning software in production, including on-call duties, debugging from logs, and resolving live issues while users wait. Familiarity with or willingness to dive into C#, TypeScript, Android, and Kotlin. Prior exposure to hardware, IoT, edge devices, payments, logistics, retail operations, or Odoo environments is highly advantageous. Demonstrated ability to dive into unfamiliar tech stacks, learn quickly, and ship reliable code. Strong passion for collaborating directly with end-users, including warehouse and operations staff, rather than exclusively with other engineers. High degree of curiosity and a proactive mindset to take full ownership of problems from end to end. Fluent English communication skills (written and spoken); knowledge of German or French is a plus. Non-smoker - we don't want you to smell like cigarettes, neither at work nor at customer meetings. After all, FELFEL is about good food. Valid work permit or Swiss passport. OUR BENEFITS Lots of delicious food, just a few steps away from your desk - we make your gastronomic dreams come true Best barista coffee and tea for the whole team, thanks to our innovative Gavetti coffee machine 5 weeks holiday per year, as well as the chance to buy an extra week of vacation Two full weeks of ‘work from anywhere’ per year to bring more variety to your work day We care about your future with an above-mandatory pension fund New parents get 16 or 3 weeks, respectively, of fully paid parental leave. We also support the return to work by making a generous financial contribution to childcare until the child reaches kindergarten age. We encourage our employees to use public transport by covering your half-fare travelcard Great team events, such as our well-known FELFEL Summer Outing Stay active and healthy with our weekly sports sessions Does this sound like the job for you? We can't wait to learn more about you! APPLY NOW with your complete documents in either German or English. ABOUT US FELFEL is all about good food and coffee in the workplace: we help Swiss employers become masters of hospitality. With our smart fridge ‘FELFEL’ and delicious barista coffee ‘Gavetti’, we enable companies to provide their employees with first-class, ultra-fresh food and drinks throughout the day. Whether hearty and traditional, modern and vegan or high in protein - our weekly changing menu ensures that all employees always have something to be excited about ;). FELFEL is a family business that was founded in 2013. Today, we take care of around 1000 locations in Switzerland, and have 150 employees across our offices in Lausanne, Zurich and New York. www.felfel.ch Find Jobs in Switzerland on Arbeitnow

title: Software Engineer, Robot Autonomy, Intern
description: Our Mission At Laelaps AI, we believe robotics is entering a transformative decade, much like the arrival of the internet. Advances in AI, cloud computing, and hardware are reshaping what autonomous systems can do. Our mission is to build the intelligent software that powers physical security in the real world - enabling robots and sensors to handle dangerous and critical tasks that humans shouldn't have to. By engineering the orchestration layer for intelligent security, we aim to create a world that is safer, more secure, and more resilient. We're a strong founding team based in Zurich, backed by visionary investors and advisors. We are engineering the future of security today! The Role As a Software Engineer intern on Robot Autonomy, you'll work on the software that runs on our legged security robots: how they perceive their surroundings, know where they are, and move through real customer sites on patrol. You'll join the team that owns everything on the robot and take a well-scoped problem from first experiment to a result that runs on hardware. The role focuses on building software for the robot autonomy stack that runs in the field. We'll agree your focus area with you during the interview process, based on your strengths and the team's priorities, and we expect you to own it from day one. This role is hands-on. You'll work with real sensor data and field logs, test on physical robots, and see first-hand why a robot that works in the lab can still fail on a live site at night, in rain, or after the layout changes. What You'll Work On Build and improve components of the on-robot autonomy stack, such as perception, localisation and state estimation, or planning and navigation, depending on your background and the team's priorities. Integrate sensors such as lidar, cameras and IMU, and work with the data they produce in day, night and challenging weather. Reproduce issues from field deployments using logs and simulation, find the root cause, and help fix it at the right layer. Design repeatable tests and clear metrics that show whether a change holds up across routes, lighting, weather and site layouts. Test your work on physical robots, and join site visits to see how the system behaves in real operating conditions. Apply solid engineering practices: code review, version control, reproducible experiments and clear documentation. Who We're Looking For We're looking for a strong robotics student who wants to see their work run on real robots, not only in simulation. You don't need every item below, but you should meet the core requirements and bring depth in at least one area of the autonomy stack. You'll join a small team that moves fast, expects ownership, and holds work to the standard of running on live customer sites. Your Background Currently pursuing a Master's or PhD, or completed a Master's degree within the last year, in Robotics, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering or a closely related field. Demonstrated depth in at least one of perception, localisation and state estimation, or motion planning and navigation, through a thesis, research or a substantial project. Strong coding skills in Python. Hands-on experience with ROS 2. Comfortable using Linux, Docker and Git in your workflows. Nice to Have Experience working with physical robots, ideally mobile or legged. Experience with lidar or camera processing, SLAM, or sensor fusion. Experience with robotics simulators such as Isaac Sim, Gazebo or MuJoCo. Publications or competition results in robotics (ICRA, IROS, RSS, CoRL). What We Offer Ownership: you are able to ship products and deliver project end-to-end. Mission: autonomous security that keeps people and critical sites safe, including in defence. Career path: a ground-floor seat with real runway. Prove your value and you will not have barriers to grow. Team: work directly with PhD-level co-founders in AI, Robotics, and Physics, alongside a strong (and fun) founding team. Compensation: Competitive equity/salary package Culture: International founding team that is serious about building but does not take itself too seriously. title: Senior Practice Leader, Developer Platform for Professional Services, APAC
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><p><strong>Available Locations: Australia, Sydney</strong></p> <p>We are seeking a highly motivated and experienced Senior Global Practice Leader for our product portfolio: Developer Platform, Professional services to join our growing team. You will take the lead to build a global practice of practitioners that can realise business outcomes for customers primarily through the capabilities within the Cloudflare developer platform.</p> <p><strong>Responsibilities:</strong><strong><br></strong></p> <ul> <li>Act as a product manager of professional services specifically for our Developer Platform;</li> <li>Prioritizes and executes on building offerings based on alignment with strategic vision.</li> <li>Review information gathered by PS Leaders and other Practice Leaders to understand offering value propositions.</li> <li>Execute on building PS offerings based on direction from Leadership.</li> <li>Builds sales collateral, scoping guidelines, project plans, delivery kits/accelerators.</li> <li>Leads effort to create and maintain selling and delivery enablement.</li> <li>Creates fixed outcome service offerings that are in-line with quick wins.</li> <li>Focuses on a-la-carte add-on services and packaged services targeting different customer profiles, E.g., Mid-Market, Enterprise, Digital Natives, Verticals</li> <li>Demonstrates good communication skills across the PS organization (Delivery Leaders, Services Sales, Consulting Delivery) and Customer Engineering Teams as well as GTM leaders for the Developer Platform product portfolio</li> <li>Own and launch internal and external marketing campaigns (e.g. blog posts, videos, webinars, internal enablement, presentation on worldwide field calls, regional leader calls, etc.) about new or improved offerings.</li> <li>Drive the team's comprehensive understanding of Cloudflare's Developer platform and capabilities, including configuration, optimization, and troubleshooting, ensuring collective expertise within the practice.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Travel:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Limited travel is expected with the only solid  requirement being attendance in person at the 6 monthly PS leadership meetings held in Lisbon and / or Austin. Some customer travel within Australia is also anticipated.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Qualifications:</strong><strong><br></strong></p> <ul> <li>Bachelor's degree in Business, Information Technology, or a related field.</li> <li>Minimum of 8 years of experience in professional services, practice architecture or leadership roles, or a developer oriented customer-facing role </li> <li>Strong understanding of the professional services landscape, including both internal and partner-provided services.</li> <li>Strong understanding of development platforms and frameworks and how they can benefit customers. In particular being able to translate business challenges into a developer platform based solution or partial solution.</li> <li>Ability to quickly prototype potential solutions for customers and then provide guidance on the migration from prototype to robust business critical application/solutions should occur.</li> <li>Demonstrable desire to educate fellow professional services staff how to leverage developer platform capabilities within their practice, respectively being Zero Trust Networking and Application services</li> <li>Excellent prior work experience as a Product Manager, Practice Manager or Architect</li> <li>Knowledge and familiarity with the Software Development Life Cycle</li> <li>Demonstrated progressive relevant experience defining, developing, and executing training strategies, operations and action plans</li> <li>Ability to quickly understand technical concepts and explain them to customer and professional services audiences (mostly technical)</li> <li>Proven ability to effectively interact with and influence senior executives and team members</li> <li>Communication, negotiation, and interpersonal skills.</li> <li>Experienced in giving and receiving constructive feedback</li> <li>Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, unpredictable environment</li> <li>Good understanding of how the Internet works, Networking and Security, Zero Trust Services/SASE, DNS, TCP/IP, HTTP, TLS, APIs and related technologies</li> <li>Experience with Jira and Salesforce (or similar CRM tool) is a plus.</li> <li>Fluency in English (written and oral) is a must. Fluency in one or more additional regional languages is a plus.</li> <li>Hands-on experience implementing and managing content delivery network (CDN), distributed denial-of-service (DDoS) protection, web application firewall (WAF), load balancing, and other related solutions for clients across various industries.</li> <li>Hands-on experience with CI/CD pipelines and associated development tools</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.</span></p> <p><a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/protecting-free-expression-online/"><strong>Project Galileo</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.</span></p> <p><strong><a href="https://www.cloudflare.com/athenian/">Athenian Project</a></strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.</span></p> <p><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"><strong>1.1.1.1</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: We released</span><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"> <span style="font-weight: 400;">1.1.1.1</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our</span><a href="https://developers.cloudflare.com/1.1.1.1/privacy/public-dns-resolver"> privacy commitment</a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs.  More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. Please note that any offer of employment may be conditioned on your authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export laws without sponsorship for an export license.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.  We are committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all people and place great value in both diversity and inclusiveness.  All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to their, or any other person's, perceived or actual</span> <span style="font-weight: 400;">race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, family care status, or any other basis protected by law. </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">We are an AA/Veterans/Disabled Employer.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities.  Please tell us if you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job. Examples of reasonable accommodations include, but are not limited to, changing the application process, providing documents in an alternate format, using a sign language interpreter, or using specialized equipment.  If you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job, please contact us via e-mail at </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">hr@cloudflare.com</span><span style="font-weight: 400;"> or via mail at 101 Townsend St. San Francisco, CA 94107.</span></p></div>

The role: You take a business-first, data-driven view of what's holding a client's growth back, use AI to diagnose it faster and deeper than a traditional audit, and turn it into a concrete plan that works. It's a long-term role with variety, autonomy, support and a clear path to grow. How we work: You own your growth, and we give you the space to work on yourself. We deliver first-class help to our clients, from start to finish. We focus on real results, not just activity. We’re great believers in powerful, real-time analytics and empowerment of the wider business. All our data lives in one place and is super easy to use. 90% of day-to-day data-driven decisions are covered by self-serve analytics through Looker which gives analysts the head space to focus on more impactful business questions and analyses.</p> <p>Join a team where your ideas can rapidly transform into reality, leveraging our cutting-edge technology and agile ways of working. SQL, Python and Looker experience is a plus</li> <li>You have experience with the development and maintenance of NPV models</li> <li>You have a strong understanding of the regulations that apply to lending in Ireland</li> <li>You thrive in a fast-paced environment and are keen for the chance to improve our products and help ship changes to our customers</li> <li>You are a strong communicator, able to cut through complex problems and articulate decision points, particularly to senior leadership</li> <li>You have experience in project management and coordination across teams</li> <li>You work well collaborating in a team with diverse skill-sets and personality types</li> <li>You are highly motivated and energised by the idea of bringing a positive impact to our customers and Monzo</li> </ul> <p><strong>🙌 What’s in it for you</strong></p> <p>💶 A salary range of €93,500 - €114,000 + Incentive Awards tied to your performance</p> <p>📍This role will have a hybrid working model, based in our Dublin office 3 days a week. title: Head of Hardware
description: Accelerating embodied AGI. The next ten years of AI will not be won in software. They will be won in the physical world: in factories, hospitals, kitchens, fields, and homes. The companies that own that data will own the century. MicroAGI is building it. We are a data research and deployment lab. Atlas captures the manual work inside Europe’s industrial champions, trains foundation models on it, and deploys the right robot onto the floor, with no teleoperation and no interruption to the line. Shift records how physical work actually happens and turns it into training-ready data. We were founded by former Formula 1 engineers from Red Bull Racing and Mercedes, together with a researcher from the Alan Turing Institute. Our $55M seed round, the largest in German history, was led by Hummingbird with Northzone, LocalGlobe, Village Global, and redalpine. We are based in Munich, with our research centre in Zürich and teams in London, New York, and Istanbul. We are now building the engineering and research teams that will take Atlas into new industries. Our models learn from data captured in the physical world, by hardware we design and build ourselves. As Head of Hardware, you own that hardware end to end: electrical, firmware, and the mechanical integration that holds it together, from the first schematic to devices running on factory floors. You lead the team that builds it. Today that is about six engineers on robotics, three on EMG sensing, and three on camera systems, plus contractors, and it will grow quickly. Our Electrical Engineer and Embedded Engineer roles report to you. You set the architecture they build against, and you still build alongside them. This is a founder-shaped role, not a management seat. We are looking for someone who has carried a product from a blank page to customers with real skin in the game, wants to build both the thing and the team that builds it, and would rather design than review. If that sounds like you, you will want to do it again at the earliest stage. What You Will Do Own the hardware roadmap for Shift and Atlas data capture: wearables, sensor rigs, camera systems, and prototype robots. What we build, in what order, and why. Set the system architecture across electrical, firmware, and mechanical: sensors, compute, power, wireless, and enclosures. Make the trade-offs, and make them stick when disciplines disagree. Stay on the bench: schematics, layout reviews, board bring-up, and a scope in your hands when the team is stuck. On the days it matters, you are the best electrical engineer in the room. Lead and grow the team: hire, set the bar, run design reviews, and give engineers ownership of whole subsystems rather than tickets. Guarantee data quality end to end: EMG and EEG front ends, camera pipelines, IMUs, and synchronization across many devices, so that what reaches the ML team is clean, time-aligned, and trustworthy. Take designs from prototype to small-batch production: DFM, component and EMS vendors, test fixtures, certification, and field reliability. Work shoulder to shoulder with ML and deployment. Your hardware decides what the training data looks like, and you will be on the floor where it is captured. Run contractors and partners without losing ownership of the result. Requirements You have taken at least one product from zero to shipped, with significant ownership of the outcome: as a co-founder, CTO, first hardware hire, or the lead who owned the whole device. Not one subsystem, not one phase. Ideally a wearable, at a tier-one hardware company known for shipping at scale. Electrical engineering is your home discipline. You have designed boards that shipped, across mixed-signal, power, wireless, and high-speed digital, and you can still do it today. You think in systems. You understand how an electrode choice, an enclosure tolerance, and an ADC sample rate interact, and you can hold the mechanical and firmware conversations as a peer, not a customer. You have led engineers: hired them, grown them, and kept a team shipping through 0-to-1 ambiguity. Typically 6+ years in hardware, but we care more about what you shipped than how long it took. A strong understanding of how hardware decisions affect data quality. You know that a great model on a noisy signal still loses to a decent model on a clean one, and you design accordingly. Experience taking hardware to small-batch production: DFM, vendor and EMS management, test, and certification. Genuinely curious about ML: you read papers, you have trained at least one model end to end, and you understand that dataset quality beats model architecture choice. High agency: you don't wait to be told what to do. A 0-to-1 hardware program takes the hours it takes, in person and at pace, and you have chosen that before. Discreet: you handle confidential hardware roadmaps and customer data with care. Nice to Have Wearables, smartwatches, drones, robotics, AR/VR, or defense wearables on your résumé. Camera systems: sensor selection, MIPI and ISP pipelines, and multi-camera synchronization. Low-power and battery design, BLE or Wi-Fi, and antenna integration in small enclosures. Enough mechanical fluency (CAD, tolerances, and materials) to challenge the mechanical team’s choices and be right some of the time. Prior founder or founding-engineer experience, including the parts that went wrong. Open-source hardware or firmware contributions. Who Will Thrive at MicroAGI Everyone we hire is assessed on the same four traits: Mission and vision: you care about what we are building and why it matters, and your past choices show it. Intensity: you work at a pace that matches the size of the opportunity, and you sustain it. Entrepreneurial: you start things nobody asked for, and you finish them. Raw IQ: you learn fast, reason from first principles, and get sharper when the problem changes. This is for you if: You would rather own a problem end to end than wait for a spec. You use AI every day, and you can tell a correct answer from a plausible one. You want to work in person, in the office, with people who are very good at what they do. This is not for you if: You are looking for a predictable 9-to-5. You would forward output you cannot explain. "That’s not my job" feels like a reasonable answer. How We Hire We read every application and reply within five working days. Talent Screen (30 min): a first conversation, both ways. Technical or Functional Interview (60 min): how you think when the problem changes. Your Work (60 min): bring something you are proud of and walk us through it. Leadership (30 min): a conversation with our CEO. Coworking Day (engineering and research roles): a day building with the team on a real problem. Then a decision, usually within a few days. Pay Transparency Compensation includes base salary and equity. The salary range for this role is shown on this posting. What We Offer Agency: real ownership from day one, and decisions that actually matter. Freedom: to choose how you solve the problem, without layers of approval. A seat on a rocketship: one of Europe’s fastest-growing deep-tech companies, at the earliest stage. Free food and drinks in the office. Equal Opportunity MicroAGI welcomes applications from everyone. We assess candidates on their work and potential, regardless of ethnic origin, gender, religion or belief, disability, age, or sexual identity. title: Head of Credit Risk Oversight
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong><em>🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.</em></strong></p> <p>We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.</p> <p>After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/personal">personal</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/business-banking">business</a> bank accounts, we offer <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/joint-account">joint accounts</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/16-17">accounts for 16-17 year olds</a>, a <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/under-16s">free kids account</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/flex">credit cards</a> in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also <a href="https://monzo.com/savings">save</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/investments">invest </a>and <a href="https://monzo.com/pensions">combine their pensions</a> with us. </p> <p>With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!</p> <p>We’re not about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo ❤️</p> <hr> <p> </p></div><p><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;">📍Dublin | 💶 €121,000 - €163,000 + Incentive Awards tied to your performance + benefits | <a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=U62l09nB0M4">Hear from the team</a> ✨</span></p> <p><strong>⭐ Our Risk team</strong></p> <p>Monzo is building a bank for Europe, and lending sits at the heart of that plan. The Head of Credit Risk Oversight is a senior risk leadership role in the Second Line of Defence (2nd LoD), shaping how Monzo Bank Europe lends as it scales across the continent. You'll join early enough to set the standard, and stay to see it grow with the portfolio. Roles like this don't come along often.</p> <p>You'll lead the oversight of Monzo Bank Europe’s whole lending business. That means driving our Credit Risk Framework, defining the risk appetite, challenging and shaping our credit strategy, and overseeing how the business executes it within that appetite, right across the credit lifecycle. You'll spot the risks inthe portfolio before they show up in the numbers, so Monzo Bank Europe can grow fast and keep growing.</p> <p>You'll also lead our credit risk analytics and measurement. You'll direct the development of our IFRS 9 expected credit loss models, make sure our impairment provisions hold up, and turn portfolio data into insight the business acts on. You'll do that with modern methods and technology, including artificial intelligence, and set the standard for how we use and control them.</p> <p>This role reports to the Director of Credit Risk, Monzo Bank Europe.</p> <p><em>The role you are applying for is a Controlled Function (CF-2) within the meaning of the Central Bank Reform Act, 2010. For this role, appointment will be conditional on Monzo being fully satisfied that the appointee meets the requirements as set out in the Fitness and Probity Standards 2018 issued by the Central Bank of Ireland. As a CF, the role holder will be subject to Conduct Standards under the Central Bank of Ireland Individual Accountability Framework and will be required to take reasonable steps to ensure that the relevant conduct standards are met.</em></p> <p><strong>🔑 You’ll play a key role by...</strong></p> <ol> <li><strong> Credit Risk Framework and Appetite</strong></li> </ol> <ul> <li>Developing, implementing and continuously improving our Credit Risk Framework in Europe, keeping it aligned to the entity's strategy.</li> <li>Formulating and overseeing the Credit Risk Appetite Statement and its limit structure, so lending growth stays inside agreed boundaries.</li> <li>Turning appetite into practical limits, triggers and escalation paths, and overseeing how the First Line of Defence (1st LoD) puts them into practice.</li> <li>Embedding group-wide credit risk frameworks locally, with clear escalation between global standards and local policy.</li> </ul> <ol> <li><strong> 2nd LoD oversight of credit risk activities</strong></li> </ol> <ul> <li>Giving independent oversight and challenge across credit policy, underwriting and credit decisioning strategies, affordability, pricing, and collections and recovery.</li> <li>Issuing formal 2nd LoD opinions on new products, policy and strategy changes, and material lending decisions.</li> <li>Reviewing portfolio asset quality regularly, including performance trends, vintage analysis and emerging pockets of risk.</li> <li>Overseeing the adequacy assessment of IFRS 9 impairment provisions, and giving a clear 2nd LoD view on whether provisions are appropriate.</li> </ul> <ol> <li><strong> Credit risk measurement</strong></li> </ol> <ul> <li>Leading the measurement of our credit risk end to end, from data and methodology through to the loss estimates we report.</li> <li>Owning the development and maintenance of the IFRS 9 expected credit loss models, including the PD, LGD, EAD and forward-looking information (FLI) inputs behind them.</li> <li>Setting the methodology for staging, significant increase in credit risk, macroeconomic scenarios and post-model adjustments.</li> <li>Keeping model documentation and evidence in good shape, and closing validation findings on time.</li> <li>Bringing advanced techniques and artificial intelligence into how we build and run these models, with the controls and transparency that come with them.</li> <li>Supplying credit risk parameters and expert input to capital, stress testing and financial planning work.</li> </ul> <ol> <li><strong> Monitoring, early warning and MI</strong></li> </ol> <ul> <li>Building credit risk monitoring and early warning processes that spot problems early.</li> <li>Delivering high quality, timely credit risk management information and insight to senior internal and external stakeholders.</li> <li>Making the numbers tell a clear story, so people can make decisions quickly and confidently.</li> </ul> <ol> <li><strong> Committee governance and independent challenge</strong></li> </ol> <ul> <li>Acting as Secretariat and Deputy Chair of the Credit Risk Oversight Committee, shaping agendas, tracking actions, and presenting 2nd LoD reports and opinions.</li> <li>Escalating credit risk appetite breaches and material risks promptly to the Executive Risk Committee and the Board Risk Committee.</li> <li>Giving clear, evidence-based challenge to 1st LoD credit, analytics and product teams, and to accountable executives.</li> </ul> <ol> <li><strong> Regulatory compliance and engagement</strong></li> </ol> <ul> <li>Making sure credit risk management meets the legal and regulatory requirements of the markets we operate in, including Central Bank of Ireland (CBI) requirements, Irish and European Union law, and European Banking Authority (EBA) and European Central Bank (ECB) guidelines.</li> <li>Leading the 2nd LoD assessment of changing and new credit regulation.</li> <li>Supporting regulatory reporting and engagement, and supporting the Director of Credit Risk on executing their PCF-22 obligations.</li> <li>Acting as a key point of contact for the CBI, internal audit and external auditors on credit risk matters.</li> </ul> <ol> <li><strong> Leadership and stakeholder management</strong></li> </ol> <ul> <li>Building the credit risk oversight function from the ground up. You'll start hands-on, then hire and lead a team as the business grows.</li> <li>Putting cutting-edge technology at the heart of how the function works from day one, including generative and agentic artificial intelligence, and making sure we control those tools as carefully as we control everything else.</li> <li>Balancing commercial ambition with rigorous risk boundaries, and helping the business grow safely.</li> </ul> <p><strong>🤩 We’d love to hear from you if…</strong></p> <ul> <li>You have a degree in a quantitative or financial discipline, such as Economics, Econometrics, Statistics, Mathematics, Finance or Financial Engineering. Further qualifications like the CFA, FRM or PRM are a strong plus.</li> <li>You've led credit risk oversight or credit risk measurement in a retail bank, challenger bank or a top financial regulatory consulting practice, ideally in a regulated European Union entity.</li> <li>You know retail credit risk modelling inside out: PD, LGD, EAD, IFRS 9 staging and expected credit loss, affordability and forward-looking information.</li> <li>You've owned or independently challenged credit risk appetite, credit policy, underwriting and collections strategies, and you can tell a strong one from a weak one.</li> <li>You understand European regulation well, including EBA and ECB guidelines, IFRS 9, the CCD2 and GDPR, and how they apply day to day.</li> <li>You have proven experience in independent engagement with with internal and external auditors and supervisory authorities, preferably the CBI and/or ECB</li> <li>You're tech-fluent, with hands-on SQL and Python, and keen to use generative and agentic artificial intelligence to speed up risk work, with clear eyes on the controls that need to come with it.</li> <li>You give clear, structured, objective challenge to 1st LoD teams, and people listen because your evidence is strong.</li> <li>You've built credit risk frameworks, models or governance from scratch, including where data is sparse.</li> <li>You can turn complex analysis into simple, useful insight for senior management and the board.</li> </ul> <p><strong>🙌 What’s in it for you</strong></p> <p>💰 A salary range of €121,000 - €163,000 + Incentive Awards tied to your performance.</p> <p>📍This role will have a hybrid working model, based in our Dublin office 2 - 3 days a week. You will also travel to Monzo’s head office in London from time to time.</p> <p>⏰ We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, and at times that suit you and your team. </p> <p>🏝 Annual Leave - 34 days including public holidays (24 holiday days + 10 public holidays)</p> <p>📚€1,200 learning budget each year to use on books, training courses and conferences.</p> <p>🏥 Private healthcare scheme</p> <p>💰Pension scheme: the minimum contribution is 4% and Monzo matches any additional contributions that you make up to a maximum of 6%</p> <p>💛 Wellbeing benefits: financial education, women’s and men’s health support, mental health benefits, including coaching and cou

title: Go (Golang) Software Engineer, Developer Tooling and Containers

Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. them.</span></p> <p><strong>Location: </strong><em><span style="font-weight: 400;">This team is based in the APAC region, these remote roles can be filled from anywhere in APAC time zones.</span></em></p> <h3><strong>The role entails</strong></h3> <ul> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Design the user experience of new capabilities in the tool</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Write high-quality code to create new features</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Obsess with correctness and robustness of your work for diverse use cases</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Go the extra mile in making sure the software performance, quality and security</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Work with teams both inside and outside of Canonical</span></li> </ul> <h3><strong>What we are looking for in you</strong></h3> <ul> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">You have professional software development experience using Go, Python, C, or C++</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">You know Linux system-level fundamentals, for example, cgroups and namespaces</span></li> </ul> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">In addition:</span></p> <ul> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">You are curious, thoughtful, articulate, and accountable</span></li> <li>Exceptional academic track record from both high school and university</li> <li>Undergraduate degree in a technical subject or a compelling narrative about your alternative chosen path</li> <li>Confidence to respectfully speak up, exchange feedback, and share ideas without hesitation</li> <li>Professional written and spoken English with excellent presentation skills</li> <li>Ability to travel internationally twice a year for company events up to two weeks long</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Nice-to-have skills</strong></h3> <ul> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Experience with LXC/LXD</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Experience with AI/ML and/or CUDA/OpenVINO</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Knowledge of system and language package managers internals</span></li> </ul> <h3><strong>What we offer colleagues</strong></h3> <p>We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. title: People Operations Specialist, Singapore (6 Month Contract)
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><p><strong>Available Location: Singapore</strong></p> <p><strong>Role summary</strong></p> <p>We are seeking a People Operations Specialist for a 6-month contract to support day-to-day HR operations with a strong emphasis on process automation, AI-assisted workflows, and scalable service delivery. Partnering closely with People Operations Manager, Specialists and cross-functional teams, you will execute core administrative tasks while actively identifying, testing, and implementing efficiency gains to reduce manual effort and improve data quality across the team.</p> <p><strong>What this role will do</strong></p> <p>Core Operations & Service Delivery</p> <ul> <li>Support end-to-end employee lifecycle processes, including onboarding, internal transfers, organizational changes, and offboarding, ensuring a positive experience for employees throughout the APJC region.</li> <li>Maintain high data accuracy across HR systems, complete transactions with strict attention to detail, and escalate complex exceptions appropriately.</li> <li>Collaborate with internal stakeholders across the regions to ensure consistent and timely execution of HR processes.</li> </ul> <p>Automation & Continuous Improvement</p> <ul> <li>Identify repetitive, manual tasks across People Operations workflows and leverage AI tools, automation, and templates to improve turnaround times.</li> <li>Assist in testing, validating, and refining new automation opportunities and AI-driven solutions.</li> <li>Monitor, track, and analyze operational data to identify process bottlenecks and recommend continuous improvement initiatives.</li> </ul> <p>Process Standardization & Knowledge Management</p> <ul> <li>Standardize and maintain SOPs, knowledge base content, templates, and onboarding checklists.</li> <li>Develop self-service resources and clear communications that enhance the overall employee experience.</li> </ul> <h4><strong>Requirement</strong></h4> <ul> <li>Relevant experience in HR operations, shared services, or similar administrative support roles.</li> <li>Highly organized with strong attention to detail, excellent problem-solving abilities, and effective time management skills.</li> <li>Proficient in working with data and skilled in Excel or Google Sheets for analysis and reporting.</li> <li>Customer-focused mindset with a genuine passion for supporting colleagues and delivering exceptional service.</li> <li>Effective communicator, able to clearly articulate information both verbally and in writing to employees across the APJC region.</li> <li>Adaptable and thrives in a fast-paced, dynamic environment, with the ability to manage shifting priorities efficiently.</li> <li>Familiarity with Workday or Zendesk would be an advantage.</li> </ul> <p> </p><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.</span></p> <p><a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/protecting-free-expression-online/"><strong>Project Galileo</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.</span></p> <p><strong><a href="https://www.cloudflare.com/athenian/">Athenian Project</a></strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.</span></p> <p><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"><strong>1.1.1.1</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: We released</span><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"> <span style="font-weight: 400;">1.1.1.1</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our</span><a href="https://developers.cloudflare.com/1.1.1.1/privacy/public-dns-resolver"> privacy commitment</a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs.  More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. Please note that any offer of employment may be conditioned on your authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export laws without sponsorship for an export license.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.  We are committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all people and place great value in both diversity and inclusiveness.  All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to their, or any other person's, perceived or actual</span> <span style="font-weight: 400;">race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, family care status, or any other basis protected by law. </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">We are an AA/Veterans/Disabled Employer.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities.  Please tell us if you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job. Examples of reasonable accommodations include, but are not limited to, changing the application process, providing documents in an alternate format, using a sign language interpreter, or using specialized equipment.  If you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job, please contact us via e-mail at </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">hr@cloudflare.com</span><span style="font-weight: 400;"> or via mail at 101 Townsend St. San Francisco, CA 94107.</span></p></div>

from problem definition and design through implementation, rollout, observability, and production support.</li> <li>Shape technical decisions for MCP Portals, including service boundaries, security customers and integrations.</li> <li>Design and review authentication and authorization flows involving Cloudflare Access, OAuth, identity, credential handling, and delegated access to upstream services.</li> <li>Improve the reliability and scalability of multi-tenant systems built on the Cloudflare Developer Platform, using production data to identify and prioritize work.</li> title: Product Manager, Safe Change & Control Plane
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><p>Available Locations:<strong> London </strong>or<strong> Austin</strong><br><br>At Cloudflare, our mission is to build a better Internet by giving customers control on they might introduce configuration changes so that they are safe, reliable, and predictable at scale.</p> <p>We are looking for a Product Manager to lead <strong>Safe Change</strong> for Cloudflare’s control plane. In this role, you will define how customers preview, stage, roll out, monitor, and recover from configuration changes. You will also shape platform foundations that enable internal teams to deploy changes with higher confidence, stronger guardrails, and lower operational risk.</p> <p>Cloudflare’s control plane converts dashboard and API changes into global network configurations. Today’s enterprise customers expect robust change-management features: deployment previews, gradual rollouts, quick rollbacks, versioning, traffic segmentation, data residency, auditability, and verification of applied state.</p> <p>You will own a high-leverage product domain spanning distributed systems, reliability, developer experience, and enterprise governance. Working closely with engineering and product leaders across the entire platform. You will help turn proven deployment safety patterns into reusable platform primitives across Cloudflare.</p> <p>This technical, highly collaborative role requires navigating architectural tradeoffs with engineers, evaluating risk and compliance with enterprise customers, and partnering with product and go-to-market teams to drive platform adoption.</p> <h2>What you’ll do</h2> <p>As a member of a growing team of infrastructure product managers your responsibilities include:</p> <ul> <li>Represent the customer, be it internal or external. Be the champion and voice of customers. Build intimate, personal customer relationships. Bring the customer's voice into the creation process.</li> <li>Develop the product vision for your area. Ensure that your vision can work not just for your current set of customers, but for 10 or even 100 times your current set. </li> <li>Evangelize the vision so that all stakeholders are aligned, have context and understand where we are going.</li> <li>Make data-driven roadmap decisions.  Make tough tactical prioritization decisions based off of data you collect, curate, and disseminate.  Build trust with stakeholders by ensuring that your roadmap is understandable and sensible based on the data you present.</li> <li>Measure success. Own the measures used to define success for your product. Success measures must be defined at the inception of a product and tracked throughout its lifecycle. Make measures visible to all stakeholders and interpret them into actionable conclusions and new hypotheses.</li> <li>Author use cases and prioritize requirements. Translate observations and customer feedback into a prioritized product backlog.  Author use cases based on specific real-world product applications and extrapolate detailed product requirements for the scenarios.</li> <li>Collaborate across teams. We win or lose as a team. Product managers play a critical role in creating alignment between engineering teams and stakeholders. A collaborative attitude is essential to the job.</li> </ul> <h2>Examples of desirable skills, knowledge, and experience</h2> <p>The ideal candidate is customer-focused, data-driven, methodical and thrives in a goal-oriented and data-driven environment.  You have a deep technical understanding of the observability space and outstanding communication and collaboration skills.  You are able to work with a diverse group, get consensus, and drive the product forward.  You are execution focused, you emphasize getting things done while paying attention to important details. You have a passion for building frameworks that scale massively and make it easy for all teams to get the most out of data as you.  </p> <p> </p> <ul> <li>4+ years of previous product management experience</li> <li>Domain expertise in making deployment decisions based on data.  You have been there, done that as either an architect or product owner for safe change or very closely related technology space</li> <li>Distributed systems experience that allows you to drive the scaling strategy for deployment as our scale grows both on volume and number of internal customers supporting.</li> <li>Experience presenting new products and features to customers – whether as a developer, analyst or product manager. You are enthusiastic about taking something you have helped build and sharing it with the world</li> <li>Strong customer and stakeholder empathy. You must be the voice of engineering, customers, support, or ops at any given time. You must be able to channel many points of view into a strategic roadmap and deliverables that provide elegant solutions to all requirements.</li> <li>Exceptional communication, presentation, organizational and analytical skills</li> <li>Demonstrated ability to lead, drive consensus and deliver in a matrixed organization with multiple stakeholders</li> <li>Experience working with large and complex data sets (SQL, Postgres, Prometheus, etc.).  You are skilled at proving points with data and can quickly show others how to do so.</li> <li>Experience with telemetry pipelines (Metrics/Traces) and a very good understanding of modern observability platforms </li> <li>Ability to communicate complex technical concepts to all audiences</li> </ul> <h2>Bonus points</h2> <ul> <li>BS/MS in a technology- or business-related field</li> <li>Experience with deployment platforms, release engineering, progressive delivery, feature flags, GitOps, IaC, or incident management.</li> <li>Background in networking, security, CDN, edge computing, observability, or large-scale SaaS environments.</li> <li>Hands-on experience with APIs, CLIs, telemetry tools, or scripting (e.g., Python, Go, JavaScript).</li> <li>Experience building platform capabilities adopted by multiple product teams.</li> <li>Experience working with enterprise customers subject to strict change-management, compliance, or data residency mandates.</li> </ul> <h2>What success looks like</h2> <p>A successful Product Manager will establish Safe Change as an adopted, trusted platform capability across Cloudflare. First-year success includes:</p> <ul> <li>A clear product strategy and roadmap for Safe Customer Change, aligned with internal rollout and control plane initiatives.</li> <li>Shipped customer capabilities for previewing and staging rollouts, backed by measurable adoption and safety metrics.</li> <li>Strong cross-functional partnerships with product and engineering teams integrating safe-change capabilities.</li> <li>A clear trajectory from near-term safety tooling to core control plane features (versioning, rollback, segmentation, data residency).</li> <li>Measurable reduction in operational risk, redundant tooling, and execution ambiguity across change workflows.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>Compensation</strong></p> <p>Compensation may be adjusted depending on work location.</p> <p> </p> <p><strong>Equity</strong></p> <p>This role is eligible to participate in Cloudflare’s equity plan.</p> <p><strong>Benefits</strong></p> <p>Cloudflare offers a complete package and fun!  The below is a description of our benefits for employees in the United States, and benefits may vary for employees based outside the U.S.</p> <p><strong>Health & Welfare Family Forming Benefits</li> <li>On-demand mental health support and Employee Assistance Program</li> <li>Global Travel Medical Insurance</li> </ul> <p><strong>Financial Benefits</strong></p> <ul> title: Software Engineer - Mission Execution
description: About Us Harmattan AI is a next-generation defense prime building autonomous and scalable defense systems. Following the close of a $200M Series B, valuing the company at $1.4 billion, we are expanding our teams and capabilities to deliver mission-critical systems to allied forces. We operate in a demanding environment where rigor, ownership, and execution are expected. About the Role As a Software Engineer, Mission Execution, you'll build the software backbone that carries mission plans from the planner to the field. You'll own the infrastructure that executes missions on autonomous robots and multi-agent systems. You'll work closely with the Mission Planning engineer, simulation engineers and product teams to make sure our systems are reliable, testable, and predictable in live operations. Responsibilities Design and build the mission execution infrastructure that turns planned missions into reliable, real-time behavior across fleets of autonomous systems. Develop scalable backend services and APIs for mission guidance, orchestration, agents communication, and execution. Set and defend a high quality bar: CI/CD pipelines, testing, code review standards, observability, and release discipline. Write production-grade C++ and Python that runs in real-time and resource-constrained environments. Partner with Mission Planning, and product teams to ensure algorithms are integrated cleanly, tested thoroughly, and deployable in the field. Analyze logs and telemetry from tests and live operations to find failure modes and drive systemic fixes. Candidate Requirements Education: M.S. or Ph.D. in Computer Science, Robotics, Aerospace Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. Technical skills: Strong coding in C++ and Python, with solid software engineering fundamentals (system design, concurrency, testing, debugging). Experience building and shipping production software : Ideally with distributed or real-time systems. Nice to have: Experience in robotics, embedded software, or video game development (game engines, simulation, deterministic replay, tooling). Experience in aerospace or defense. Familiarity with simulation frameworks. Mindset: Strong communication skills, Rigor, ownership, and a strong instinct for quality. Commitment: 100% dedication to Harmattan AI's mission, vision, and ambitious growth plans, ready to go the extra mile to ensure operational excellence. We look forward to hearing how you can help shape the future of autonomous defense systems at Harmattan AI. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Switzerland on Arbeitnow

title: Executive Assistant
description: This is Cradle Proteins are the molecular machines of life, used for many therapeutic, diagnostic, chemical, agricultural and food applications. Designing and optimizing proteins takes a lot of expert knowledge and manual effort, through the use of custom computational and biological tools. Machine learning is revolutionizing this space, by enabling high-fidelity protein models. At Cradle, we offer a software platform for AI-guided discovery and optimization of proteins, so that biologists can design proteins faster and at scale. We are already used by clients across biopharma, biotech, agri-tech, food-tech, and academia. We're an experienced team of just under 100 people. We've built many successful products before and have enough funding for multiple years of runway. We are distributed across three offices in Amsterdam, Boston, and Zurich, alongside a few remote colleagues. We offer our employees a very competitive salary, a generous equity stake in the company and a wide range of benefits and career progression opportunities. The Role As Executive Assistant at Cradle, you'll keep two of our founding executives moving. Between customer visits, investor meetings, hiring and travel across Amsterdam, Zurich and the US, there's a lot to keep track of, and your job is to make sure nothing gets dropped. You'll own their calendars, inboxes and travel, and take care of the personal admin that would otherwise eat into their time. This role suits someone who likes being trusted with the whole picture, professional and personal, and treats both with the same care. Responsibilities Run two calendars as one system: Protect focus time, balance competing priorities across time zones, and decide what deserves a meeting and what can be an email. Own the inbox front line: Triage, draft and reply on their behalf to customers, investors, candidates and the team, so the important things surface and the rest gets handled. Plan travel end to end: Customer visits, conferences and trips between Amsterdam, Zurich and the US, from flights and hotels to the meeting room and dinner booking on the other side. Take care of personal and life admin: Appointments, household logistics, official paperwork, bills and renewals, handled so none of it lands on their desks. Prepare every important meeting: Make sure briefs and context are ready beforehand, and follow up on decisions and action items afterwards. realistic project plans, manage dependencies, and oversee execution to meet commitments and deliver with predictability.</p> </li> <li> <p>Excellent communication skills, with the ability to tailor
