This critical role is part of the Infrastructure Operations organization, which is responsible for building, scaling, and running Cloudflare's data center and network infrastructure across 700+ sites worldwide.</p> <p>The DCSC team manages physical access control and compliance auditing across one of the most complex and distributed infrastructure footprints in the industry, spanning more than 105 vendor portals, hundreds of non-portal carrier-neutral and edge partner sites, and multiple regulatory frameworks including SOC 2, ISO 27001, FedRAMP, ISMAP, and IRAP. The operational burden of this work is substantial and largely manual: user lists are pulled by hand, access control lists are reconciled by eye, evidence packages are assembled ticket by ticket, and attestation cycles consume weeks of coordinator time every quarter.</p> <p>This role exists to change that. The DCSC Automation -Specialist will design, build, and operate AI-assisted and automated workflows that eliminate the most time-consuming manual work in the DCSC operating model, freeing compliance coordinators to focus on exception handling, stakeholder relationships, and regulatory judgment rather than data gathering and reconciliation.</p> <p>This is a builder role. covering 338+ sites.</li> <li>Resilience & Coverage: Build fallback handling for portals that block or rate-limit automated access; document exceptions and maintain a coverage registry tracking automation status per portal.</li> <li>Scheduled Execution: Operationalize extraction jobs on a recurring cadence aligned to QAR and MAR cycles, with alerting for failures and drift.</li> </ul> <ol> <li><strong> ACL Reconciliation & Diff Engine</strong></li> </ol> <ul> <li>Automated Comparison: Build tooling that ingests portal-extracted user lists and compares them against the master Access Control List (ACL), automatically surfacing discrepancies: users present in a portal but absent from the ACL, users on the ACL without active portal access, and role or access-level mismatches.</li> <li>Exception-Only Output: Route confirmed discrepancies directly to pre-populated Jira tickets for human review and action, eliminating the need for coordinators to perform full manual review of every user record each quarter.</li> <li>Audit Trail: Ensure all comparison runs produce immutable, timestamped records suitable for SOC 2, ISO 27001, and FedRAMP evidence requirements.</li> </ul> <ol> <li><strong> Attestation & Evidence Automation</strong></li> </ol> <ul> <li>Attestation Module: Own and extend the attestation workflow within the DCSC Portal, including automated cycle triggering, manager notification, time-stamped confirmation capture, and exception escalation, replacing manual screenshot-based evidence gathering.</li> <li>Evidence Package Builder: Build automated pipelines that compile audit-ready evidence packages for SOC 2, ISO 27001, FedRAMP, ISMAP, and IRAP control cycles, pulling attestation logs, portal extraction results, diff reports, and correspondence into structured packages keyed to specific control IDs.</li> <li>GRC Alignment: Work directly with GRC counterparts to validate that automated evidence formats meet auditor and regulatory requirements before deployment.</li> </ul> <ol> <li><strong> AI-Assisted Anomaly Detection & Triage</strong></li> </ol> <ul> <li>Access Pattern Analysis: Implement LLM-based review passes over QAR cycle output to surface patterns warranting human escalation: former employees retaining access, access creep over time, dormant accounts, and anomalous role assignments across sites.</li> and preventing missed steps across multi-portal provisioning workflows.</li> <li>Continuous Improvement: Monitor automation output quality over time, retrain or recalibrate models as portal structures change, and maintain a feedback loop with coordinators on false positives and missed detections.</li> </ul> <ol> <li><strong> DCSC Portal Ownership & Tooling Roadmap</strong></li> </ol> <ul> <li>Platform Stewardship: Own the DCSC Portal as the operational runtime for all automation and workflow tooling ensuring it remains stable, documented, and usable by coordinators without engineering support for day-to-day tasks.</li> <li>Roadmap Management: Maintain a prioritized backlog of automation opportunities, assessed by time savings, compliance impact, and implementation complexity; present quarterly progress and priorities to DCSC leadership.</li> <li>Documentation: Produce runbooks for every automation, ensuring that no operational capability lives only in one person's head or on a local machine.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Desirable skills / Experience:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Automation Engineering: Demonstrated experience building browser automation (Playwright, Puppeteer, title: Director, Global Design & Construction
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. You will be responsible for leading the end-to-end design and construction of workspaces that serve as the tangible, physical manifestation of the local Cloudflare culture.</p> <p>At the same time, you are stepping into uncharted territory. To keep Cloudflare at the absolute forefront of our industry, we are up-leveling how we deliver projects by integrating an AI-first, data-driven approach. We are looking for a visionary leader who can think outside the box to identify and implement how AI can automate workflows, optimize budgets, and improve data-driven design decisions.</p> <p>While automation and AI are the engines of efficiency in this role, the <strong>human element</strong> is its heart. Ensure all construction activities and global workflows are in strict compliance with local laws while maintaining a focus on sustainable, high-performance building standards.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Examples of Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience</strong></h3> <ul> <li><strong>Proven Seniority:</strong> 10-12+ years of experience leading interior design and complex construction project management, specifically within high-growth technology companies or global enterprises.</li> <li><strong>Scale Mastery:</strong> A proven track record of successfully directing a global corporate office portfolio in excess of 250,000+ total square feet.</li> <li><strong>Curiosity & Growth Mindset:</strong> A profound curiosity for how technology can optimize human interaction. You must be comfortable with ambiguity and excited by the challenge of building unprecedented internal tools from scratch rather than managing legacy workflows.</li> <li><strong>Technical Integration:</strong> Knowledge of technical infrastructure (MEP systems, architectural principles, AV/IT) and a clear vision of how they connect with automated building systems.</li> <li><strong>Sophisticated Communication:</strong> Outstanding leadership and collaboration skills, with a demonstrated ability to influence cross-functional executives and external partners across multiple time zones.</li> <li><strong>Education:</strong> Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in a related field such as Architecture, Project Management, Interior Design, or Engineering.</li> <li><strong>Global Mobility & Presence:</strong> Willingness to work in-office ~3 days a week to lead by example within our local workplace laboratory, with the flexibility to travel globally to oversee high-stakes project transformations.</li> </ul> <h4><strong>Nice-to-Have Skills</strong></h4> <ul> <li><strong>Certifications:</strong> LEED, WELL, or PMP Certifications.</li> <li><strong>Advanced Technical Skills:</strong> Experience with AI-enhanced workflows, generative design platforms, or transitioning legacy portfolios into AI-assisted operational models.</li> </ul> <p><strong> </strong></p> <p><strong>Compensation</strong></p> <p>Compensation may be adjusted depending on work location.</p> <ul> <li><span data-sheets-root="1">For Bay Area based hires: Estimated annual salary of $223,000 - title: Director, Strategic Finance & Investor Relations
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><p><strong>Available Locations: New York, NY, San Francisco, CA</strong></p> <h4><strong>About the team </strong></h4> <p>The Finance team is a critical pillar of Cloudflare’s success, translating strategy into financial outcomes, and serving as a trusted voice to the public markets, the Board, and our shareholders. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in. Come join us!</p> <h4><strong>About the role</strong></h4> <p>Cloudflare is looking for a Director of Strategic Finance & Investor Relations to serve as a key leader on our Investor Relations team and a trusted partner to the CFO, CEO, and senior leadership. This role reports to the VP of Strategic Finance, Treasury, Deal Desk, & Investor Relations and is the engine room of how Cloudflare tells its financial story to the public markets — translating one of the most differentiated technology platforms in the world into a clear, credible, and compelling investment narrative.</p> <p>You will own the end-to-end quarterly earnings cycle, drive our long-term financial model and consensus discipline, partner directly with the CFO and senior leadership on guidance, and lead the analytical and communications work behind every major investor and analyst touchpoint — quarterly calls, conferences, our annual Investor Day, and ad-hoc executive projects. You will be the connective tissue between Finance, Accounting, Legal, Communications, Product, Sales, and the executive team, and the person who makes sure every number, every claim, and every word we put in front of Wall Street is accurate.</p> <p>This is a high-visibility, high-ownership role on a very lean IR team. We move fast, we ship work that goes directly to the CEO, CFO, Board, and public markets, and we hold ourselves to an exceptionally high bar on accuracy — and we are AI-native in how we work, treating modern tooling as a force multiplier on insight, productivity, and rigor.</p> <h4><strong>What you’ll do</strong></h4> <p>As the Director, Strategic Finance & Investor Relations, you will be the operational and analytical lead for Cloudflare's engagement with the public markets. Your primary responsibilities will include:</p> <p><strong>Quarterly earnings and consensus management</strong></p> <ul> <li>Own the end-to-end quarterly earnings process: press release, supplemental financial information, prepared remarks (CEO and CFO scripts), Q&A prep, investor deck, and supporting validation work.</li> <li>Partner with the CFO and senior leadership to develop the company's guidance (including share count forecasting) and own the executive-facing materials that frame guidance decisions, sensitivity ranges, and the trade-offs in how we communicate them.</li> <li>Lead the Q&A preparation process — anticipated questions, suggested answers, peer transcript triangulation, key stats and proof points, and live-call backup material.</li> <li>Lead the post-earnings analyst callback program, including coordinating callbacks with ~30 sell-side analysts across CEO and CFO sessions.</li> <li>Drive earnings materials validation — the cross-check pass that ensures every figure, claim, and disclosure across the press release, supplemental, scripts, Q&A, deck, 10-Q, and 10-K ties out and is internally and externally consistent.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Investor engagement and external communications</strong></p> <ul> <li>Serve as a primary point of contact for sell-side analysts and institutional investors; build and maintain strong, trust-based relationships with our covering analysts and shareholders.</li> <li>Articulate the Cloudflare investment narrative — our connectivity cloud strategy, the Workers and Developer Platform story, and our long-term financial model — in a way that is both compelling and credible.</li> <li>Plan and execute the calendar of investor events: sell-side conferences, one-on-ones, on-site investor visits, and our annual Investor Day.</li> <li>Prepare the CEO, CFO, and other senior executives for every investor interaction with tailored briefing materials, talking points, and Q&A prep.</li> <li>Develop and maintain core IR collateral: investor presentation, fact sheets, IR website content, and board-of-directors investor update materials.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Investor Day and special projects</strong></p> <ul> <li>Co-lead the planning and execution of our annual Investor Day — invite tracker and registration management, co-author all presentation content and prepared remarks across all presenters, own the supporting documentation, validation, day-of logistics, and post-event follow-through.</li> <li>Lead select strategic finance projects: peer benchmarking analyses, long-range financial modeling, competitive analyses, and ad-hoc executive-level financial analyses.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Cross-functional partnership and analytics</strong></p> <ul> <li>Be a trusted partner to Finance, Accounting, Legal, Communications, FP&A, and the executive team — the person who knows where every number comes from and what it means.</li> <li>Monitor and synthesize analyst coverage, peer performance, investor sentiment, market dynamics, and industry trends; To achieve this, our internal operations must run seamlessly, securely, and efficiently. We are seeking a highly skilled, forward-thinking <strong>Senior Enterprise Systems Developer</strong> to join our Enterprise Systems team with a dedicated focus on our core financial operations: the Order-to-Cash (O2C), Revenue Management, and Record-to-Report (R2R) ecosystems.</p> <p>In this role, you will be the primary technical owner for the applications that drive our billing, collections, revenue recognition, general ledger management, and financial consolidations. Your core tech stack will include <strong>NetSuite, Zuora RevPro, and Oracle Fusion Cloud (Financials - O2C and R2R modules)</strong>. Your primary customers will be the Revenue Accounting, Billing, Corporate Accounting, and broader Finance organizations, and you will partner closely with them to optimize how Cloudflare transacts, recognizes revenue, and reports financials at scale.</p> <p>If you are a builder at heart who enjoys solving complex financial system workflows, automating the month-end close, leveraging AI for financial insights, and designing seamless enterprise integrations from Quote-to-Cash through to the General Ledger, this role is for you.</p> <h2><strong>What You'll Do</strong></h2> <h3><strong>Application Administration & Environment Management</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Serve as the primary subject-matter expert and developer for Cloudflare’s O2C and R2R technology stack (NetSuite, Zuora RevPro, Oracle Fusion).</li> <li>Manage user provisioning, complex role-based access control (RBAC), and security settings specific to billing approvals, journal entry (JE) limits, general ledger access, and revenue posting.</li> <li>Manage application environments (e.g., Production vs. Sandbox/Release Preview), ensuring alignment across all environments from both a data and release perspective to support safe testing of financial changes.</li> <li>Monitor ongoing application performance and reliability, managing incident workflows to ensure ticket SLAs for the Finance organization are consistently met, especially during critical month-end and quarter-end close periods.</li> <li>Provide Tier 3 support and end-user enablement, serving as the ultimate technical escalation point for financial system issues.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>System Development, Integrations & AI Initiatives</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Act as the Subject-Matter Expert for integrations across the QTC, O2C, and R2R lifecycles. Ensure the seamless flow of data (e.g., syncing closed-won opportunities to NetSuite/Oracle, passing billing data to Zuora RevPro, and ensuring subledger transactions map flawlessly to the GL).</li> <li>Design, build, and deploy custom system enhancements, automated billing schedules, journal entry automations, revenue allocation scripts (e.g., SuiteScript), and API integrations between our platforms.</li> <li>Lead the evaluation, implementation, and governance of native AI features within the financial stack (e.g., AI-driven anomaly detection in journal entries and revenue schedules, automated cash application matching, or intelligent account reconciliations) to accelerate financial operations.</li> <li>Proactively monitor vendors' quarterly updates and product roadmaps. Lead impact assessments, manage versioning/upgrades, and educate Finance stakeholders on new functionality and AI opportunities.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Process Management & Workflow Design</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Partner directly with the Chief Accounting Officer's organization, Revenue Accounting, Corporate Accounting, and Billing teams to deeply understand their operational processes and translate business requirements into sophisticated system solutions.</li> <li>Own the design, configuration, and delivery of complex workflows (e.g., dynamic invoice routing, automated dunning processes, intercompany eliminations, and month-end close orchestrations) to eliminate manual bottlenecks.</li> <li>Build and maintain scalable system architectures that support complex, high-volume recurring billing, usage-based consumption models, and multi-entity global consolidations.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Security, Compliance, & Data Governance</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Partner closely with Internal Audit, Risk, and Compliance teams to maintain robust IT General Controls (ITGC) and strict enterprise-wide data governance for financial and customer data.</li> <li>Spearhead and execute <strong>Quarterly Access Reviews (UAR)</strong> for all O2C and R2R applications, ensuring accurate access levels and enforcing strict Segregation of Duties (SoD) across billing, revenue, and general ledger operations.</li> <li>Ensure newly implemented AI features, custom scripts, and data-sharing protocols strictly adhere to SOX compliance, maintain data integrity, and ensure audit readiness for all financial records and ASC 606 reporting.</li> <li>Maintain comprehensive system architecture documentation, process maps, and business continuity/disaster recovery plans for critical financial systems.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What We're Looking For</strong></h2> <ul> <li><strong>Minimum Experience:</strong> Bachelor’s degree in MIS, Computer Science, Finance, Accounting, or a related field. 5+ years of hands-on experience in enterprise systems development and administration, with a strong focus on Financial ERPs.</li> <li><strong>Platform Expertise:</strong> Deep, proven experience configuring, administrating, and developing in applications like <strong>NetSuite, Zuora RevPro, and Oracle Fusion Cloud (specifically O2C and R2R/GL modules)</strong>.</li> <li><strong>Integration & Development Skills:</strong> Strong understanding of system integration logic (REST/SOAP APIs) and data flows across Quote-to-Cash, Order-to-Cash, and Record-to-Report ecosystems. Experience with scripting languages native to the platforms (e.g., NetSuite SuiteScript) is highly preferred.</li> <li><strong>AI & Innovation Acumen:</strong> Familiarity with deploying, testing, or administering AI and machine learning features within SaaS platforms, specifically tailored to financial operations, journal anomaly detection, or cash application.</li> <li><strong>Audit & Compliance Acumen:</strong> Extensive experience working in a strict SOX-compliant public company environment. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><p><strong>Available Location - </strong>Lisbon, Portugal, Spain</p> <p><strong>Role Summary</strong></p> <p>As a Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) at Cloudflare, you will serve as a senior technical expert and advisor for our most strategic and complex customers. This role balances deep technical expertise with hands-on, onsite engagement, where you will architect solutions, optimize performance, and drive business success by helping customers maximize the value of Cloudflare’s platform. You will collaborate cross-functionally with Sales, Support, Product, and Engineering to advocate for customer needs and influence our product roadmap. We are looking for a seasoned technologist who thrives on solving real-world challenges and acting as a trusted advisor within our customers' unique environments.</p> <p><strong>Role Responsibilities</strong></p> <ul> <li>Serve as a trusted advisor to key enterprise customers, providing strategic recommendations and technical insights to drive success with Cloudflare’s solutions, specifically Workers and Workers AI platforms.</li> <li>Lead architectural discussions, design sessions, and solution reviews to ensure the optimal application of Cloudflare’s offerings in customer environments.</li> <li>Diagnose complex technical issues and deliver effective, strategic solutions in close collaboration with support and product teams.</li> <li>Manage and navigate complex configurations, utilizing Infrastructure as Code (Terraform) to ensure operational stability for customers.</li> <li>Partner with Sales, Customer Success, Support, Partners, Product Management, and Engineering to ensure customer insights directly influence the product roadmap and enhance the overall experience.</li> <li>Advise customers on industry best practices for security, network optimization, scalability, and performance tuning tailored to their specific operational needs.</li> <li>Stay current with industry trends and evolving Cloudflare solutions to provide forward-thinking guidance and configuration enhancements.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Role Requirements (Must-Have Skills)</strong></p> <ul> <li>In Depth Experience in a technical customer-facing role such as Solutions Architect or Technical Account Manager, ideally within cloud networking, security, or web infrastructure.</li> <li>Extensive knowledge of Cloudflare’s Application and Security portfolio (DNS, WAF, DDoS, Bot Management, CDN) and cloud infrastructure.</li> <li>Hands-on experience protecting and securing web applications, APIs, and web services using WAF, DDoS, DNS, and Bot Management tools.</li> <li>Proven ability to work with Cloudflare products within Enterprise-level accounts.</li> <li>Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present complex topics effectively to both technical and non-technical audiences.</li> <li>Strong consultative skills with a track record of successfully solving complex technical problems in customer environments.</li> <li>Ability to translate customer requirements into practical, scalable solutions that align with Cloudflare’s technology stack.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Nice-to-Have Skills</strong></p> <ul> <li>Hands-on experience with coding, Cloudflare Workers, and Workers AI.</li> <li>Prior experience in customer onsite placement.</li> </ul> <p data-path-to-node="2">For Portugal based hires: Estimated annual salary is between €80,000 - €110,000.</p> <ul data-path-to-node="3"> <li> <p data-path-to-node="3,0,0">The final offer will be inclusive of time exemption, in alignment with the applicable law and collective bargaining agreements.</p> </li> </ul> <p> </p><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.</span></p> <p><a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/protecting-free-expression-online/"><strong>Project Galileo</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.</span></p> <p><strong><a href="https://www.cloudflare.com/athenian/">Athenian Project</a></strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.</span></p> <p><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"><strong>1.1.1.1</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: We released</span><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"> <span style="font-weight: 400;">1.1.1.1</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. This role demands the ability to deeply understand complex customer IT Architectures, match them with relevant Cloudflare Reference Architectures, and orchestrate successful, large-scale platform sales. Strategically connect disparate needs to strengthen Cloudflare's platform sale, actively involving and influencing technical C-level minus one executives.</li> <li><strong>Virtual Team Leadership:</strong> Set clear direction and lead a virtual team of in-GEO specialists, Product Managers, Deal Desk, and Legal to collaboratively manage and close complex customer opportunities. Proactively identify and navigate through situations to address colleague and customer needs, escalating as appropriate to drive urgency and efficient delivery.</li> <li><strong>Digital Transformation Authority:</strong> Act as an authority on digital transformation, understanding key drivers (e.g., new offering development, enhanced customer capabilities) and the broader market trends influencing these decisions. Lead with a strong focus on the "why," communicating the whole picture to both internal and external stakeholders.</li> <li><strong>Advanced Negotiation & Closure:</strong> Expertly lead and navigate complex contract negotiations, driving win-win scenarios for all parties. Demonstrate advanced closing skills across new business and expansion opportunities.</li> <li><strong>Trusted Advisor & Coach:</strong> Build long-term, executive-level strategic relationships, ensuring deep customer adoption, retention, and expansion. Share learnings proactively to build trust across the organization.</li> <li><strong>Organizational Impact & Leadership:</strong> Consistently focus on the long-term needs of the team and the business, understanding how decisions impact other teams and openly sharing these insights. model</strong>, with a significant track record of consistently exceeding multi-million dollar quota targets.</li> <li><strong>Deep expertise and fluency in Cloud Networking, Security, and Edge Computing technologies</strong>, with an exceptional ability to articulate features, benefits, and use cases across diverse customer segments (e.g., SMBs, enterprise, vertical markets).</li> per the SYNTEC Collective Bargaining Agreement.</li> </ul> </li> </ul> <p>This role is eligible to earn incentive compensation under Cloudflare’s Sales Compensation Plan. Hardware Integration Operations sits at the heart of this engine, bridging the gap between hardware engineering design, global supply chains, and data center deployment. Our mission is to ensure our global infrastructure scales seamlessly, reliably, and efficiently by optimizing rack integration, supplier ecosystems, and lifecycle operations.</p> <p>About the Role</p> <p>As Manager of Hardware Integration Operations, you will lead a multidisciplinary team responsible for supply coordination, rack engineering readiness, third-party integration, and deployment coordination. You will manage employees across supply-chain operations, rack integration engineering, and technical program management while scaling the team’s capabilities.</p> <p>You will own the team’s day-to-day execution and operating model, ensuring L11 rack builds have the materials, technical requirements, supplier capacity, and deployment readiness needed to support Cloudflare’s infrastructure plans. You will also develop long-term strategy, including scaling global integration capacity, improving rack lifecycle operations, expanding integration capabilities, and influencing data center standards that enable greater use of rack integration.</p> <p>This role requires a blend of strategic leadership and hands-on operational engagement. priorities, clarify ownership, and develop and execute a workforce plan that expands the team’s capabilities and capacity.</p> </li> </ul> <h3>Own Rack Integration Operations</h3> <ul> <li> <p>Oversee covering schedule adherence, material readiness, supplier capacity, and ERP data accuracy.</p> </li> </ul> <h3>Guide Technical Readiness and Standards</h3> <ul> <li> <p>Lead the team’s contribution to requirements while influencing structured cabling and data center standards that enable deployment-ready racks.</p> </li> </ul> <h3>Lead Suppliers and Commercial Operations</h3> <ul> <li> <p>Drive relationships with global L11 integration suppliers, including performance reviews, capacity commitments, and escalations.</p> </li> <li> <p>Partner with Hardware Sourcing on regional expansion, commercial negotiations, and L11 operating-budget governance.</p> </li> </ul> <h3>Expand Rack Integration Capabilities</h3> <ul> <li> <p>Develop and scale programs that increase the range of work logistics.</p> </li> <li> <p><strong>Process & Financial Acumen:</strong> Strong judgment in managing operational budgets, demand forecasts, production metrics, and cross-functional process development.</p> </li> <li> <p><strong>Global Collaboration & Travel:</strong> Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to influence cross-functional stakeholders across Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><h3><strong>Available Location: Toronto, Canada</strong></h3> <h3><strong>About Us</strong></h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p> <h3><strong>What you will do as a Customer Engineer</strong></h3> <p>The Customer Engineer (CE) is the core driver of our technical go-to-market strategy: a trusted technical advisor and primary architect of the customer journey. You will bridge the gap between technical strategy and business value—guiding enterprise clients from initial pre-sales technical validation through onboarding, deployment architecture, and full lifecycle expansion. Sitting within the GTM organization and reporting to a Customer Engineering Leader, you will not hand off your customers once an initial agreement is reached. Instead, you will operate as a quota-carrying technologist, leveraging AI-augmented workflows to eliminate administrative toil so you can focus on high-value architectural design and driving measurable business outcomes across the entire customer journey.</p> <p><strong>Key Responsibilities</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Technical Validation: </strong>Partner closely with Account Executives to lead technical deep-dive discovery, capture business requirements, and map complex customer infrastructure - DNS, CDN, Zero Trust, Network Security, Workers - to fit-for-purpose Cloudflare architectures and bespoke solutions. . Define, scope, success criteria, and technical evaluations plans for Proof of Concepts (PoCs) and Technical Validations. Deliver tailored technical presentations, architectural diagrams, and demonstrations that show how Cloudflare solves specific performance, security, and reliability challenges. Proactively address complex technical objections, security compliance questions, and edge-case architectural requirements during the sales cycle. Take accountability for a suitable solution deployment strategy (Customer, Partner or Cloudflare Professional services) being an integral part of all proposals.</li> <li><strong>Customer Adoption & Value Realization: </strong>Provide oversight to technical onboarding and implementation, but not execute the implementation, serving as the primary executive and engineering contact for the customer. Proactively monitor customer health scores and telemetry to ensure rapid time-to-value, resolve integration bottlenecks, and reduce deployment risk.</li> <li><strong>Commercial Accountability & Expansion: </strong>Carry a variable quota tied directly to new business acquisition and/or ongoing account growth. Be commercially accountable for ensuring deep platform adoption, retaining revenue, and identifying strategic cross-sell and up-sell opportunities based on product usage data. Lead technical Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) to translate platform capabilities into return on investment for C-level executives.</li> <li><strong>Trusted Advisory: </strong>Act as a trusted technical advisor throughout the entire customer lifecycle, maintaining a continuous, deep relationship with key stakeholders from initial onboarding through maturity, renewal, and expansion. Provide thought partnership on architecture, AI control layers, security posture, and deployment confidence. Identify potential deployment risks or integration bottlenecks early, and provide remediation strategies to de-risk customer outcomes. </li> <li><strong>AI Orchestration & Workflow Automation: </strong>Leverage AI agents, Large Language Models (LLMs), and internal platforms to automate routine tasks such as RFP/Security Questionnaire responses, sandbox provisioning, basic telemetry monitoring, and internal/external documentation, reclaiming your time for strategic customer advisory.</li> <li><strong>Education & Enablement:</strong> Partner closely with the Enablement Team to design, build, and govern technical resources. Define, document, and educate both internal teams and customers on deliverables such as Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), architectural best practices, and technical guides to continuously raise the technical baseline across the organization.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Minimum Qualifications</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience: Experience in a customer-facing technical role, such as Solutions Engineering, Customer Engineering, Professional Services,  Sales Engineering, Technical Account Management, or as a Forward Deployed Engineer (years of experience required will vary based on Associate, Senior, Staff, or Principal leveling).</li> <li>Architectural Mindset: Ability to white-board, design, and articulate complex enterprise network and security architectures clearly.</li> <li>Consultative & Advisory Skills: Excellent communication skills with the ability to translate deeply technical concepts into business outcomes for both hands-on engineers and C-level executives.</li> <li>Commercial Mindset: Proven track record of operating in a quota-carrying or revenue-aligned environment, with a strong understanding of SaaS metrics, business value translation, and enterprise sales cycles.</li> <li>Communication: Exceptional presentation and stakeholder management skills, capable of bridging the gap between deep technical implementation details and high-level C-suite business strategy.</li> <li>Technical Breadth: We do not expect every candidate to be an expert in every domain. Qualified candidates will demonstrate depth in at least four of the technical areas below:</li> <ul> <li>Internet fundamentals: Deep understanding of how the Internet works, including OSI Model layers 1–7, BGP, GRE, TCP/UDP, DNS (authoritative and recursive), HTTP(S), and SSL/TLS.</li> <li>Security: Expertise in the security of Internet properties, including WAF, Bot Management, Firewalls, Rate Limiting, (M)TLS, Zero Trust, and SASE concepts.</li> <li>Performance: Expertise in the performance of Internet properties, including speed, latency, caching, video streaming, HTTP/2, and TLS 1.3.</li> <li>AI Proficiency: Familiarity with prompt engineering, AI-assisted scripting and log analysis, LLM utilization, and workflow automation to augment everyday CE workflows.</li> <li>Coding/Scripting: Proficiency in Python, JavaScript, Bash, Lua, Go, or similar languages to write custom integration scripts, API connectors, and edge computing functions.</li> <li>Developer Platform Fluency: Experience designing, building, deploying or scaling applications using RESTful/GraphQL APIs, SDKs, webhooks, and developer tooling in cloud-native environments. Familiarity with infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, Pulumi), CI/CD pipelines, and observability for developer-led deployments.</li> </ul> </ul> <p><strong>Strongly Preferred Qualifications (The "Good-to-Haves")</strong></p> <ul> <li>Technical Enablement: Track record of creating and delivering technical enablement - workshops, code samples, documentation, or developer onboarding - that accelerates customer adoption of complex platforms. </li> <li>Applied AI Knowledge: Experience with LLM orchestration, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) architectures, and model-access controls.</li> <li>Regulatory Knowledge: Understanding of regulatory requirements such as PCI DSS, HIPAA, and SOC 2.</li> <li>Hyperscaler / Digital Native Background: Talent coming out of hyperscalers, digital natives, distributed systems environments, or startups is strongly valued for its deeper cloud fluency and advanced architecture depth.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Education</strong></p> <p>Undergraduate or graduate degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field. </p> <p><strong>Travel</strong></p> <p>This role may require travel up to 20–50% to attend customer meetings, conferences, industry events, and in-person team collaboration.</p> <p><strong>Compensation</strong></p> <p>This

Cloudforce One works in close partnership with external organizations and internal Cloudflare teams, continuously developing operational tradecraft and expanding ever-growing sources of threat intelligence to enable expedited threat hunting and remediation. Together, these teams form a unified capability: from tracking an adversary's infrastructure to dismantling it at network scale.</p> <h4><strong>What you'll do</strong></h4> <p>Cloudflare is a system spanning the globe, on a mission to make the internet better, safer, and more powerful every day. You think like an attacker and build like an engineer who has been burned by production incidents at 3 AM. You are energized by hard problems, impatient with the status quo, and have a track record of shipping solutions that others said couldn't be done.</p> <p>This role may require flexibility to be on-call outside of standard working hours to address technical issues as needed.</p> <h4><strong>Responsibilities</strong></h4> <ul> <li>Drive architectural direction and technical strategy across Cloudforce One engineering, spanning services that run in Kubernetes, on the edge (Workers, D1), and across Cloudflare's global network.</li> <li>Identify and dismantle technical bottlenecks, legacy patterns, and architectural debt that slow down threat detection and abuse response — then replace them with systems that are faster, more reliable, and more elegant.</li> <li>Design and build critical data pipelines and services to collect, enrich, analyze, and expose threat intelligence and abuse signals at massive scale, helping identify Tactics, Techniques, and Procedures (TTPs) and and other engineering teams to translate complex security and compliance requirements into scalable, production-grade solutions.</li> <li>Mentor and elevate the engineering talent around you — set the bar for code quality, system design, operational rigor, and security-first thinking across both organizations.</li> <li>Develop and champion agentic AI workflows and AI-assisted development practices that accelerate threat hunting, detection engineering, and abuse investigation.</li> <li>Own the operational excellence of the systems you touch, including participation in on-call rotations and incident response.</li> </ul> <h4><strong>Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience:</strong></h4> <ul> <li>15+ years of cyber security experience with an emphasis on building systems to present adversarial trends and techniques both as an internal reputational service and a product facing analyst service.</li> <li>10+ years of experience building and operating large-scale distributed systems in production, with demonstrated expertise in complex system architecture and design.</li> <li>Deep, hands-on proficiency in Go and/or TypeScript, with production experience deploying services in Kubernetes and on edge computing platforms (e.g., Cloudflare Workers, D1/SQLite-at-the-edge).</li> <li>Subject matter expertise in threat intelligence, adversarial analysis, or detection engineering — you understand the Cyber Kill Chain, know how to track TTPs, and can reason about attacker infrastructure at scale.</li> <li>Proven ability to work across organizational boundaries and lead technical initiatives that span multiple teams, codebases, and problem domains simultaneously.</li> <li>Experience with AI-assisted development and agentic AI workflows.</li> <li>Strong architectural judgment — you know when to build, when to refactor, and when to burn it down and start over.</li> <li>Experience designing and operating critical data pipelines (Kafka, Temporal, or similar) and working with SQL databases (PostgreSQL) and caching layers (Redis) at scale.</li> <li>Excellent communication skills — you can explain a complex system design to a VP and debug a race condition with a junior engineer in the same afternoon.</li> <li>A track record as a disruptor: you have examples of fundamentally improving how a team, system, or organization operates, not just shipping features.</li> title: Principal People Team Business Partner - R&D
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><h3>Available Locations</h3> <ul> <li>US</li> </ul> <p><strong>Applications will be accepted until September 20, 2026.</strong></p> <h2>About the role</h2> <p>Cloudflare is growing our People team. Our focus is finding the best people to work at Cloudflare and then allowing them to do their best work. As we continue to scale our global organization, we are looking for a trusted Business Partner who is naturally curious about our technology, deeply invested in our business strategy, and driven to help our people thrive.In this role, you will report to the Senior Director, People Team Business Partners and serve as a heavy-hitting strategic partner to our senior leadership across Product, Engineering and Security.</p> <p>You won't just execute HR programs; you will actively architect them. You will focus on macro-level organizational design, sophisticated talent management strategies, systemic change leadership, and workforce planning that aligns directly with our aggressive business goals. Moving at our pace brings a lot of change, complexity, and ambiguity—and a little bit of chaos. Cloudflarians thrive on that and are comfortable being uncomfortable. You will bring critical thought, deep business acumen, and a strong point of view to help our leaders navigate this unrelenting pace, transforming potential friction into high-impact execution.</p> <h2>Responsibilities</h2> <ul> <li><strong>Strategic Advisory:</strong> Act as a trusted advisor to R&D executive leadership, translating business objectives into long-term workforce strategies, organizational designs, and succession plans.</li> <li><strong>Insight-Driven Problem Solving:</strong> Synthesize complex qualitative and quantitative data—leveraging AI-driven insights and engagement analytics—to proactively identify trends, mitigate risks, and design predictive people solutions.</li> <li><strong>Change Leadership:</strong> Guide leadership and teams through structural evolutions, hyper-growth scaling, and shifting business priorities with minimal disruption to engagement and output.</li> <li><strong>Talent & Capability Building:</strong> Partner with business leaders and People team Centers of Excellence (COEs) to design high-impact initiatives around talent development, performance elevation, and total rewards.</li> </ul> <h2>Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience</h2> <ul> <li>Motivated by cultivating high-performance culture, building great businesses, and helping people do their best work, you are a seasoned, consultative People leader. You don't just adapt to the future of work—you actively leverage modern tools and a relentless curiosity to shape it.</li> <li><strong>Experienced & Proven:</strong> You have 12+ years of progressive experience on a People/HR team, with at least 3+ years operating as a principal business partner backing complex, fast-paced corporate functions.</li> <li><strong>Business-First Strategist:</strong> You possess keen business acumen and effortlessly link HR strategy to commercial and operational outcomes. You think like a business leader who happens to specialize in people, always looking for ways to enable teams to hit their goals.</li> <li><strong>Relentlessly Curious:</strong> You possess an innate curiosity about what we build, how our teams operate, and what makes our people tick. You dive deep into the data and the dynamics of your organizations to diagnose root causes rather than just treating symptoms.</li> <li><strong>AI & Tech Savvy:</strong> You embrace modern innovation, utilizing AI and advanced digital tooling as strategic force multipliers. You leverage AI to enhance your personal productivity, streamline operational efficiency, and uncover data-driven insights that solve complex organizational challenges. <em>(And yes, you still secretly love a sophisticated spreadsheet!)</em></li> <li><strong>Architect of Change:</strong> You have a proven track record of leading large-scale change initiatives through highly ambiguous environments. You know what organizational complexity looks like and possess the resilience and resourcefulness to drive ideation into concrete action.</li> <li><strong>Program Builder:</strong> You have built scalable, enterprise-grade programs from the ground up and have a demonstrated history of establishing immediate credibility and trust across all levels of a distributed, virtual organization.</li> <li><strong>Empathic Influencer & Communicator:</strong> You lead with empathy but do not shy away from radical candor. Cloudforce One works in close partnership with external organizations and internal Cloudflare teams, continuously developing operational tradecraft and expanding ever-growing sources of threat intelligence to enable expedited threat hunting and remediation.</p> <p>Members of Cloudforce One are at the helm of leveraging an incredibly vast and varied set of data points that only one of the world's largest global networks can provide. The team analyzes these unique data points at massive scale and efficiency, synthesizing findings into actionable threat intelligence to better protect our customers.</p> <h2><strong>About INTERDICT</strong></h2> <p><strong>I.N.T.E.R.D.I.C.T.</strong> (Identify, Neutralize, Triage, Engage, Respond, Disrupt, Integrate, Contain, Threat Hunting) is Cloudforce One's unified operational security organization responsible for identifying, analyzing, and responding to threats targeting Cloudflare and its customers. INTERDICT encompasses three main sub-functions:</p> <ul> <li><strong>PhishGuard:</strong> Email Managed Detection and Response (MDR) service.</li> <li><strong>Cloudflare Managed Defense (CMD, Formerly SOCaaS):</strong> 24/7 monitoring, detection, and mitigation of security events across Cloudflare products.</li> <li><strong>Detection Engineering:</strong> Develops, maintains, and deploys Cloudflare’s threat detection logic across email, application, and network telemetry.</li> </ul> <p>Through the combined capabilities of CMD, PhishGuard, and Detection Engineering, INTERDICT delivers a cohesive operational security function that provides continuous, proactive protection against network, application, and email-based threats. This integrated structure ensures rapid detection, coordinated response, and improved security outcomes for Cloudflare and its customers.</p> <h2><strong>About the Role</strong></h2> <p>The Response Engineer within the Cloudflare Managed Defense Center acts as a primary technical responder for Cloudflare's premium enterprise customers. You will autonomously investigate complex threat telemetry, handle live incident response for sophisticated volumetric DDoS and application-layer attacks, and analyze traffic anomalies during high-pressure events.</p> <p>Customers contact the Managed Defense Center for assistance and intelligence across Cloudflare's security portfolio, focused on two core pillars: Web Application Security (WAF and Bot Management) and DDoS mitigation across network and application layers. <br><br>Managed Defense Response Engineers use customer-facing dashboards and internal tools to make detailed and informed suggestions for mitigation, and may implement mitigation strategies directly on behalf of the customer. The team provides continuous proactive monitoring and analysis of security events through internal alerting systems. </p> <p>We are looking for an analytical security practitioner who thrives in this always-on operational environment and bridges the gap between deep technical analysis and premium customer advisory.</p> <h3><strong><em>Role Responsibilities</em></strong></h3> <ul> <li>Implement robust mitigation strategies for complex attacks across OSI Layers 3, 4, and 7 using Cloudflare's suite (Magic Transit, Magic Firewall, Advanced TCP Protection, Advanced DNS Protection, WAF, Custom protocol exhaustion and application-layer exploitation, translating findings into custom, highly targeted mitigation rules</li> <li>Review alerts to determine relevancy and urgency, proactively escalate customer-impacting incidents, and adhere to Customer SLAs for alert response and customer communication</li> <li>Act as the primary technical contact for customers during active security incidents, driving high-touch, consultative communication (via phone, chat, email) with customers' technical engineering teams to neutralize threats while ensuring stable traffic delivery</li> <li>Continuously tune and optimize existing security monitoring rules and alerting thresholds to improve the operational signal-to-noise ratio and reduce false positives</li> <li>Lead managed customer onboarding sessions, maintain customer-specific runbooks, and deliver highly technical monthly security posture reviews and post-incident reports</li> <li>Partner directly with internal engineering, product, and threat intelligence teams to provide actionable feedback on attack trends, tooling gaps, and product enhancements</li> </ul> <p><strong><em>Role Requirements</em></strong></p> <ul> <li>4–7 years of direct, hands-on experience in Managed Detection and Response (MDR), advanced Security Operations, or high-level Technical Support/Incident Response for enterprise infrastructure</li> <li>Proven capability to handle both Application Security (including knowledge of OWASP Top 10 vulnerabilities, L7 WAF, HTTP/S anomalies, Bot mitigation) and Network Security (L3/L4 volumetric DDoS, protocol abuse)</li> <li>Working knowledge of threat frameworks such as MITRE ATT&CK to classify adversary behavior and inform detection and mitigation strategies</li> <li>Operational understanding of internet protocols including TCP, UDP, ICMP, GRE, BGP, DNS, with the ability to quickly diagnose attack fingerprints and infrastructure impact during volumetric DDoS attacks</li> <li>Hands-on experience with packet capture (e.g., tcpdump, Wireshark, tshark) or HTTP traffic inspection (e.g., HAR, Burp Suite) to analyze malicious traffic</li> <li>Extensive experience managing technical description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><h3><strong>Available Location: Bentiville, AR<br></strong></h3> <hr> <p><strong>About Us</strong><br>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.<br><br><strong>What you will do as a Customer Engineer</strong><br>The Customer Engineer (CE) is the core driver of our technical go-to-market strategy: a trusted technical advisor and primary architect of the customer journey. You will bridge the gap between technical strategy and business value—guiding enterprise clients from initial pre-sales technical validation through onboarding, deployment architecture, and full lifecycle expansion. Sitting within the GTM organization and reporting to a Customer Engineering Leader, you will not hand off your customers once an initial agreement is reached. Instead, you will operate as a quota-carrying technologist, leveraging AI-augmented workflows to eliminate administrative toil so you can focus on high-value architectural design and driving measurable business outcomes across the entire customer journey.<br><br><strong>Key Responsibilities</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Technical Validation: </strong>Partner closely with Account Executives to lead technical deep-dive discovery, capture business requirements, and map complex customer infrastructure - DNS, CDN, Zero Trust, Network Security, Workers - to fit-for-purpose Cloudflare architectures and bespoke solutions. . Define, scope, success criteria, and technical evaluations plans for Proof of Concepts (PoCs) and Technical Validations. Deliver tailored technical presentations, architectural diagrams, and demonstrations that show how Cloudflare solves specific performance, security, and reliability challenges. Proactively address complex technical objections, security compliance questions, and edge-case architectural requirements during the sales cycle. Take accountability for a suitable solution deployment strategy (Customer, Partner or Cloudflare Professional services) being an integral part of all proposals.</li> <li><strong>Customer Adoption & Value Realization: </strong>Provide oversight to technical onboarding and implementation, but not execute the implementation, serving as the primary executive and engineering contact for the customer. Design structured migration and onboarding blueprints tailored to the customer’s environment (e.g. DNS migrations, Zero Trust rollouts, WAF tuning guidance), and act as the lead consultant for customer engineering teams, walking them step-by-step through configuration best practices.  Partner with Account Executives to own discovery, demos, onboarding, technical health, risk, and expansion strategy. Proactively monitor customer health scores and telemetry to ensure rapid time-to-value, resolve integration bottlenecks, and reduce deployment risk.</li> <li><strong>Commercial Accountability & Expansion: </strong>Carry a variable quota tied directly to new business acquisition and/or ongoing account growth. Be commercially accountable for ensuring deep platform adoption, retaining revenue, and identifying strategic cross-sell and up-sell opportunities based on product usage data. Lead technical Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) to translate platform capabilities into return on investment for C-level executives.</li> <li><strong>Trusted Advisory: </strong>Act as a trusted technical advisor throughout the entire customer lifecycle, maintaining a continuous, deep relationship with key stakeholders from initial onboarding through maturity, renewal, and expansion. Provide thought partnership on architecture, AI control layers, security posture, and deployment confidence. Identify potential deployment risks or integration bottlenecks early, and provide remediation strategies to de-risk customer outcomes. </li> <li><strong>AI Orchestration & Workflow Automation: </strong>Leverage AI agents, Large Language Models (LLMs), and internal platforms to automate routine tasks such as RFP/Security Questionnaire responses, sandbox provisioning, basic telemetry monitoring, and internal/external documentation, reclaiming your time for strategic customer advisory.</li> <li><strong>Education & Enablement:</strong> Partner closely with the Enablement Team to design, build, and govern technical resources. Define, document, and educate both internal teams and customers on deliverables such as Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), architectural best practices, and technical guides to continuously raise the technical baseline across the organization.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Minimum Qualifications</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience: Experience in a customer-facing technical role, such as Solutions Engineering, Customer Engineering, Professional Services,  Sales Engineering, Technical Account Management, or as a Forward Deployed Engineer (years of experience required will vary based on Associate, Senior, Staff, or Principal leveling).</li> <li>Architectural Mindset: Ability to white-board, design, and articulate complex enterprise network and security architectures clearly.</li> <li>Consultative & Advisory Skills: Excellent communication skills with the ability to translate deeply technical concepts into business outcomes for both hands-on engineers and C-level executives.</li> <li>Commercial Mindset: Proven track record of operating in a quota-carrying or revenue-aligned environment, with a strong understanding of SaaS metrics, business value translation, and enterprise sales cycles.</li> <li>Communication: Exceptional presentation and stakeholder management skills, capable of bridging the gap between deep technical implementation details and high-level C-suite business strategy.</li> <li>Technical Breadth: We do not expect every candidate to be an expert in every domain. Qualified candidates will demonstrate depth in at least four of the technical areas below:</li> <ul> <li>Internet fundamentals: Deep understanding of how the Internet works, including OSI Model layers 1–7, BGP, GRE, TCP/UDP, DNS (authoritative and recursive), HTTP(S), and SSL/TLS.</li> <li>Security: Expertise in the security of Internet properties, including WAF, Bot Management, Firewalls, Rate Limiting, (M)TLS, Zero Trust, and SASE concepts.</li> <li>Performance: Expertise in the performance of Internet properties, including speed, latency, caching, video streaming, HTTP/2, and TLS 1.3.</li> <li>AI Proficiency: Familiarity with prompt engineering, AI-assisted scripting and log analysis, LLM utilization, and workflow automation to augment everyday CE workflows.</li> <li>Coding/Scripting: Proficiency in Python, JavaScript, Bash, Lua, Go, or similar languages to write custom integration scripts, API connectors, and edge computing functions.</li> <li>Developer Platform Fluency: Experience designing, building, deploying or scaling applications using RESTful/GraphQL APIs, SDKs, webhooks, and developer tooling in cloud-native environments. Familiarity with infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, Pulumi), CI/CD pipelines, and observability for developer-led deployments.</li> </ul> </ul> <p><strong>Strongly Preferred Qualifications (The "Good-to-Haves")</strong></p> <ul> <li>Technical Enablement: Track record of creating and delivering technical enablement - workshops, code samples, documentation, or developer onboarding - that accelerates customer adoption of complex platforms. </li> <li>Applied AI Knowledge: Experience with LLM orchestration, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) architectures, and model-access controls.</li> <li>Regulatory Knowledge: Understanding of regulatory requirements such as PCI DSS, HIPAA, and SOC 2.</li> <li>Hyperscaler / Digital Native Background: Talent coming out of hyperscalers, digital natives, distributed systems environments, or startups is strongly valued for its deeper cloud fluency and advanced architecture depth.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Education</strong><br>Undergraduate or graduate degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field. <br><br><strong>Travel</strong><br>This role may require travel up to 20–50% to attend customer meetings, conferences, industry events, and in-person team collaboration.<br><br><strong>Compensation</strong><br>This role features a competitive base s

description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><h2>Available Location: Pittsburgh, PA</h2> <h2>About the Role</h2> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. As the architectural complexity of enterprise solutions scales, we are evolving how we partner with our customers. The Customer Engineer (CE) represents the core driver of our technical go-to-market strategy: a trusted advisor who owns the technical relationship from the initial discovery phase through to long-term adoption and ongoing account expansion.</p> <p>Sitting within the GTM organization and reporting to the Regional Customer Engineering Leader, you will not hand off your customers once an initial agreement is reached. Instead, you will operate as a quota-carrying technologist, utilizing AI-augmented workflows to eliminate administrative toil so you can focus on high-value architectural design and driving measurable business outcomes across the entire customer journey.</p> <h2>Responsibilities</h2> <ul> <li><strong>Technical Validation:</strong> Partner closely with Account Executives to lead technical discovery, build bespoke architectures, and deliver compelling product demonstrations and Proof of Concepts (PoCs) across Cloudflare’s portfolio (Security, Networking and Developer Platforms).</li> <li><strong>Customer Adoption & Value Realization:</strong> Lead and/or provide oversight to technical onboarding and implementation, serving as the primary executive and engineering contact for the customer. You will partner with Account Executives to own discovery, demos, onboarding, technical health, risk, and expansion strategy. You will proactively monitor dynamic customer health scores and telemetry to ensure rapid time-to-value and resolve integration bottlenecks.</li> <li><strong>Commercial Accountability & Expansion:</strong> Carry a variable quota tied directly to new business acquisition and/or ongoing account growth. You will be commercially accountable for ensuring deep platform adoption, retaining revenue, and identifying strategic cross-sell and up-sell opportunities based on product usage data. Lead technical Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) to translate platform capabilities into return on investment for C-level executives.</li> <li><strong>Trusted Advisory: </strong>Act as a trusted technical advisor throughout the entire customer lifecycle, maintaining a continuous, deep relationship with key stakeholders from initial onboarding through maturity, renewal, and expansion.</li> <li><strong>AI Orchestration & Workflow Automation:</strong> Act as an "AI-Augmented" engineer. strategic customer advisory.</li> </ul> <h2>Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience</h2> <ul> <li><strong>Experience:</strong> Experience in a customer-facing technical role, such as Solutions Engineering, Customer Engineering, Sales Engineering, or as a Forward Deployed Engineer (years of experience required will vary based on Associate, Senior, Staff, or Principal leveling).</li> details and high-level C-suite business strategy.</li> </ul> <h2>Bonus Points</h2> <ul> <li><strong>Cloudflare AI Stack Experience:</strong> Hands-on experience building, deploying, or architecting engineering, Large Language Model (LLM) orchestration, or Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) architectures.</li> <li><strong>Coding/Scripting:</strong> Proficiency in Python, JavaScript, or similar languages to write custom integration scripts, API connectors, and edge computing functions.</li> </ul> <h2><span style="font-size: 14px;">Compensation</span></h2> <p>This role features a competitive base salary and a variable commission structure tied directly to the successful execution of full-lifecycle commercial targets, including new business acquisition, ongoing adoption milestones, and
